item.title: Trump's approval holds at record low as US support for Iran war falls, Reuters Ipsos poll finds
item.description: U.S. public approval of the war with Iran fell to its lowest level since the conflict's early days, helping to hold President Donald Trump's popularity at a record low, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: U.S. public approval of the war with Iran fell to its lowest level since the conflict's early days, helping to hold President Donald Trump's popularity at a record low, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday. The four-day poll showed just 31% of Americans support U.S. military action against Iran, down from 37% in a March Reuters/Ipsos poll and 34% earlier this month. The decline was driven by fewer self-identified Republicans backing the conflict. Some 69% of Republican respondents support the war, compared with 77% in March. The war has been dragging on Trump's public standing this year, and for the second survey in a row just 33% of respondents said they approved of the Republican's performance in the White House, the lowest level in Reuters/Ipsos polls in Trump's first or second term. Trump has told Americans that the war - which started with U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran on February 28 - is necessary to keep Tehran from developing a nuclear weapon. The conflict has cooled in recent months but Iran has kept in place a de facto blockade of oil exports from the region, which has pushed U.S. gasoline prices near record highs. Trump has vowed to ramp up economic pressure on Iran and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday announced a possible expansion of sanctions on countries doing business with the country, but stopped short of actually imposing penalties, a sign of how thorny the conflict has become for the administration. FEARS OF A LONG WAR Some 83% of the country thinks the war will go on "for an extended period of time," the latest Reuters/Ipsos poll found, up from 80% earlier this month. Trump campaigned ahead of the 2024 presidential election on promises to control inflation and avoid lengthy military conflicts. Six months into the war with Iran, U.S. gasoline prices are more than a dollar higher per gallon than they were before the war. That is weighing on Trump's Republican allies who will be defending narrow congressional majorities in the November 3 midterm elections. Independent voters in the poll favored Democrats over Republicans - 33% to 19% - when asked who they would vote for in congressional elections if the election were held today. The poll surveyed 1,215 U.S. adults nationwide and had a margin of error of 3 percentage points in either direction.

item.title: Federer playing Flushing Meadows exhibition in long overdue US Open sendoff
item.description: Roger Federer will make a long-awaited curtain call for his adoring fans at Flushing Meadows on Tuesday as the man who defined a generation of tennis plays in an exhibition event ahead of the U.S. Open singles main draw.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Roger Federer will make a long-awaited curtain call for his adoring fans at Flushing Meadows on Tuesday as the man who defined a generation of tennis plays in an exhibition event ahead of the U.S. Open singles main draw. His final U.S. Open match in 2019 lacked the romantic sendoff that fans have come to expect for former champions, as the Swiss exited in the quarter-finals with many expecting him to return to play at the event again. But he was absent from the U.S Open in 2020 and played in his final slam at Wimbledon in 2021, leaving the New York tournament he once dominated without a proper farewell. "It really gives me a true opportunity to say thank you, goodbye, which is I think important for some," said Federer, whose five consecutive wins are unmatched by any man in the Open Era. "For me it is, and it's a nice thing to do." Tuesday's exhibition, "US Open: Roger Federer - An Icon Returns to NY," was fetching upwards of $2,000 on Ticketmaster's resale platform on Monday, and the Swiss Maestro said he only hoped he could hit the right notes after a long layoff. "It's nerve-wracking, to be honest. I haven't played a single set in - I don't know - maybe five years. Don't know how it's going to go tomorrow," he told reporters. "There's a lot of uncertainty, but a lot of happiness that I can return." Federer will play alongside fellow retired greats Andy Roddick, Andre Agassi and John McEnroe at Arthur Ashe Stadium, where newly un-retired American Serena Williams is due to play mixed doubles with Carlos Alcaraz earlier in the day. The 44-year-old Williams' return to New York had Flushing Meadows buzzing on Monday, as fans had already begun to flood the plaza to catch some of the singles qualifying tournament. Asked if he would ever consider accepting a wild card to the singles competition, Federer, who is only one year Williams' senior, was emphatic: "No, no, no, no, no, no." "I've got just way too many obstacles and I'm too busy - I'm barely finding time to play any exos," said Federer, who is due to be inducted in the Tennis Hall of Fame on Saturday. "The body is done." The U.S. Open men's and women's singles main draw begins on Sunday.

item.title: Tesla interrompe venda de telhados solares uma década após lançamento
item.description: A Tesla deixou de vender telhas solares em seu site, quase uma década depois que o presidente-executivo, Elon Musk, lançou o produto como uma alternativa mais atraente aos painéis solares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Tesla deixou de vender telhas solares em seu site, quase uma década depois que o presidente-executivo, Elon Musk, lançou o produto como uma alternativa mais atraente aos painéis solares. A página da Tesla sobre telhas solares agora redireciona para uma oferta de painéis solares. A Tesla não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Musk apresentou as telhas em 2016, quando a Tesla buscava adquirir a SolarCity, a empresa de instalação de sistemas solares administrada por seus primos. Em 2021, a empresa havia estabelecido uma meta de 1.000 instalações por semana, mas estimativas do setor indicavam que o número real era bem menor. A estratégia solar da Tesla mudou para os painéis tradicionais, que a empresa produz em sua fábrica em Buffalo, Nova York, e começou a entregar a clientes residenciais neste ano. Musk ainda tem grandes ambições no setor solar. A Tesla apresentou planos no Texas neste mês para uma fábrica de células solares de US$10,1 bilhões nos arredores de Houston. (Por Nichola Groom)

item.title: Exportação de café do Brasil no mês já supera agosto de 2025 com alta de 50%, diz Secex
item.description: A exportação de café verde do Brasil já superou, até a terceira semana do mês, o volume registrado em agosto completo do ano passado, com aumento de mais de 50% na média diária de embarques, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) publicados nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A exportação de café verde do Brasil já superou, até a terceira semana do mês, o volume registrado em agosto completo do ano passado, com aumento de mais de 50% na média diária de embarques, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) publicados nesta segunda-feira. No acumulado do mês até o dia 24 de agosto, as exportações somaram 153,8 mil toneladas, ante 142,9 mil toneladas em todo o mês do ano passado. Pela média diária, por dia útil, a exportação somou 10,25 mil toneladas, contra 6,8 mil toneladas em agosto de 2025. O salto apontado nos embarques de café -- em um ano em que o Brasil deve registrar uma colheita recorde -- acontece após exportações mais lentas do que o previsto em julho, uma vez que chuvas atrapalharam os fluxos de colheita. As chuvas que atrapalharam a colheita no maior produtor e exportador global foram fator de suporte nos preços globais. Com a colheita de café do Brasil em estágio mais avançado agora, já superando [USN:S0N44203V TEXT:"90%"] das lavouras, o foco climático se volta para as floradas para a próxima safra. Há expectativa de precipitações "significativas" nesta semana, com volumes mais elevados no Cerrado Mineiro e reflexos nas demais regiões produtoras de arábica, como Sul de Minas, São Paulo e Matas de Minas, disse o analista de Inteligência de Mercado da StoneX, Leonardo Rossetti, em nota nesta segunda-feira. Ele apontou ainda que novas pancadas de chuvas esperadas para o início de setembro podem funcionar como um gatilho para boa parte das floradas nas áreas de café arábica.

item.title: Cameroon federation chief Eto'o backs FIFA's Infantino
item.description: Cameroon's all-time top scorer Samuel Eto'o, president of the country's soccer federation, has defended FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, saying opposition to the Swiss-Italian was related to the timing of next year's elections in the global body.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cameroon's all-time top scorer Samuel Eto'o, president of the country's soccer federation, has defended FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, saying opposition to the Swiss-Italian was related to the timing of next year's elections in the global body. Infantino, up for re-election in March 2027, has been criticised since tabling a [USN:L1N43X04P TEXT:"now abandoned proposal"] to sell off a 20% stake in a commercial body for FIFA tournament rights, with several countries [USN:L1N44008Y TEXT:"withdrawing their support"] for his candidacy. "I think all these things are happening because of the timing. There's an election coming up where Gianni Infantino is standing. All of this has happened because there's an election coming up. That's all there is," Eto'o told CNN in an interview broadcast on Monday. While several regional soccer bodies, including UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF, are weighing whether to move a [USN:L6N44H116 TEXT:"vote of no confidence"] to oust Infantino, African body CAF has [USN:L1N4490XL TEXT:"backed him"]. CAF president Patrice Motsepe said earlier this month that Infantino's future should be decided at the 2027 election, and confirmed that the president still has the support of CAF. Former striker Eto'o, who played for major European clubs like Real Madrid, Barcelona, Inter Milan and Chelsea, said Infantino had changed football, giving opportunities to nations that did not have them before. "The president's job is to take football further, to make all of the nations grow," he said. "He made a proposal. The 211 members were supposed to sit down, debate the issue and let the majority win. But I am convinced that the voices that were raised, those are not the voices of the majority."

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu says Iran tried to kill one of his sons
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday that Iran had tried to kill one of his sons, but gave no details about when the alleged plot took place, which son was targeted or how close it came to being carried out.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday that Iran had tried to kill one of his sons, but gave no details about when the alleged plot took place, which son was targeted or how close it came to being carried out. Netanyahu's allegation underscores the heightened tensions since the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran began in February, during which Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other senior Iranian leaders were killed. Netanyahu, whose coalition is trailing in opinion polls two months before an October 27 general election, made the claim in a telephone interview with Israel's Channel 14. He was responding to reports that one of Israel's security agencies had refused to provide protection for a political rival ahead of the nationwide vote. "As for my sons. Here, I think there is something quite unbelievable, yes. Iran targeted one of my sons. Iran tried to kill, to murder one of my sons," Netanyahu told the conservative channel known for its favourable coverage of the government. "Iran tried to murder one of my sons, and therefore this security protection is not a luxury," he said, without providing any further details about the alleged plot or how close it came to being carried out. It was not immediately clear which of his sons he was referring to. Netanyahu's elder son, Yair, lives in Miami. Iran's mission at the United Nations in New York did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the accusation. Netanyahu also said he had told the Shin Bet security agency chief David Zini that appropriate security should be provided for any prime ministerial candidate. Israeli media had reported earlier that Zini declined to provide security for Gadi Eisenkot and told the country's election authority there was no plot to harm him. Eisenkot's party is projected to win the largest number of seats in the election, although Israeli governments are usually formed through coalitions among multiple parties rather than by a single party winning a parliamentary majority outright.

item.title: US ethanol credit prices slump after EPA delays biofuel compliance deadline
item.description: Prices for U.S. ethanol blending credits plunged on Monday to their lowest levels in more than four months, market sources said, after the Environmental Protection Agency said it would extend a September 1 compliance deadline for refiners and rule on long-pending small refinery exemption requests by the end of August.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale, Shariq Khan
item.content:encoded: Prices for U.S. ethanol blending credits plunged on Monday to their lowest levels in more than four months, market sources said, after the Environmental Protection Agency [USN:S0N3YU01Z TEXT:"said"] it would extend a September 1 compliance deadline for refiners and rule on long-pending small refinery exemption requests by the end of August. Conventional ethanol Renewable Identification Numbers (D6 RINs) traded at $1.75 each at 12:45 p.m. ET, down 34 cents from Friday and their lowest level since April 15, according to Argus Media. The credits had traded as high as $2.50 on July 7. Biomass-based diesel RINs for 2026 were last assessed at around $1.92 each, their weakest level since late April, Argus data showed. Under the Renewable Fuel Standard, a federal program aimed at increasing renewable fuel usage, refiners are required to show they had met their 2025 biofuel blending mandates by September 1, either by generating Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs) through blending biofuels into the nation's fuel supply or by purchasing those credits from other market participants. Jessica Dell, head of U.S. biofuel pricing at Argus Media, said RIN prices lost substantial value again during Monday's session in response to the EPA's impending small refinery exemption decisions. RIN prices had fallen 5% on Friday. The EPA is reviewing 34 exemption petitions, some dating back to July 2024. The timing of those decisions has been a major source of uncertainty for the market, especially after the agency finalized [USN:S0N3YU01Z TEXT:"record-high"] renewable fuel blending requirements for 2026 and 2027 which have added to their compliance burdens, Dell said. Extending the compliance deadline is seen as signaling some form of “RIN relief” for refiners' 2026 and 2027 obligations as well, Scott Irwin, an agricultural economist at the University of Illinois said. Market participants expect the EPA's rulings to free up a significant number of credits. Representatives of the refining and ethanol industries and an analyst estimate that the exemptions could free up between 1.2 billion and 1.8 billion RINs that small refiners could use to meet their 2025 compliance obligations. The EPA had previously indicated it could reallocate 990 million RINs associated with exemptions. One senior trader said RINs collapsed as speculation began of SRE relief at around 1.8 billion, a surprise compared to the roughly 1.3 billion the market had been expecting.

item.title: Tesla stops selling solar roofs a decade after launch
item.description: Tesla has stopped selling premium solar roof tiles on its website, nearly a decade after CEO Elon Musk launched the product as a more attractive alternative to panels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tesla has stopped selling premium solar roof tiles on its website, nearly a decade after CEO Elon Musk launched the product as a more attractive alternative to panels. Tesla's solar roof url now redirects to a solar panels offering. Discontinuation of the product was first reported by Electrek last week. Tesla did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Musk [USN:L1N1CZ012 TEXT:"unveiled"] the roof tiles in 2016 as Tesla sought to acquire SolarCity, the solar installer run by his cousins. The company in 2021 had targeted 1,000 installations per week, but industry estimates said the actual figure was [USN:L4N3613UE TEXT:"far less"]. Tesla's solar strategy has shifted to traditional panels, which it produces at its factory in Buffalo, New York, and began delivering to residential customers this year. Musk still has big ambitions in solar. Tesla filed plans in Texas this month for a $10.1 billion solar-cell factory outside Houston that would create 9,712 permanent jobs.

item.title: 米、韓国との上陸訓練中止 イラン戦争で兵力に制約
item.description: [ソウル ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２４日 ロイター] - 米国が韓国との間で来月に予定していた合同上陸訓練「双竜」を中止した。韓国海兵隊の報道官が記者会見で２４日に明らかにした。米政府はイラン戦争を理由に、米軍の兵力確保に制約があると説明した。

米海兵隊は韓国海兵隊に６月に正式に通告したという。

同報道官は、訓練再開に向けて両国が緊密に協議を続けていると述べた。今後の中止を防ぐ手だてや、中止となった訓練を補完する方策について、具体的な言及はなかった。

在韓米軍のコメントは得られていない。

item.title: Tribunal apelación FIA tendrá la última palabra sobre el podio de Gasly en el Gran Premio de Mónaco
item.description: El tribunal de apelación de la Fórmula 1 se reunirá el martes en París para decidir de una vez por todas quién quedó tercero en el Gran Premio de Mónaco, más de dos meses después de la carrera.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: El tribunal de apelación de la Fórmula 1 se reunirá el martes en París para decidir de una vez por todas quién quedó tercero en el Gran Premio de Mónaco, más de dos meses después de la carrera. Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, fue tercero el 7 de junio, pero fue relegado al séptimo puesto cuando los comisarios le impusieron tras la carrera dos sanciones de cinco segundos por exceso de velocidad en el pit lane, lo que permitió a Isack Hadjar, de Red Bull, ascender al último escalón del podio. Esa decisión fue revocada el 12 de junio, después de que los comisarios aceptaran las pruebas presentadas por Alpine —propiedad de Renault— de que se había producido un error de cronometraje y retiraran las sanciones, con lo que Hadjar devolvió el trofeo a Gasly. Ante las advertencias de algunos expertos del paddock de que el veredicto había abierto la caja de Pandora, McLaren y Red Bull recurrieron ante el tribunal internacional el 16 de junio. McLaren planteó sus objeciones después de que Oscar Piastri, que cayó del cuarto al quinto puesto tras la reinstauración de Gasly, recibiera sanciones durante la carrera por la misma infracción, partiendo de la base de que era inevitable, aunque él estaba seguro de no haber excedido la velocidad. A diferencia de Gasly, que no cumplió sus sanciones durante la carrera y al que se le añadió un tiempo que podía eliminarse, Piastri no tuvo recurso alguno, y el tiempo perdido en boxes también tuvo un efecto en cadena en la forma de correr del australiano a partir de ese momento. El jefe del equipo, Andrea Stella, declaró durante el Gran Premio de los Países Bajos del fin de semana —ganado por Lando Norris, de McLaren— que la apelación tenía un doble objetivo. "Creemos que el proceso que tuvo lugar tras la carrera de Mónaco debe revisarse porque, desde el punto de vista de la equidad para todos los competidores, el hecho de que se retirara la sanción plantea algunos motivos de preocupación significativos", afirmó. "El segundo aspecto es el interés de McLaren. También nos vimos penalizados de forma sustancial por haber cumplido una sanción que no era apelable y esto incluso nos costó puntos en el campeonato", añadió. La FIA indicó que la audiencia, a la que no asistirán el público ni los medios de comunicación por motivos de confidencialidad, se celebrará en la sede de la FIA y que la decisión se publicará lo antes posible.

item.title: Bolsas europeas se mantienen estables, mercados evalúan tensiones con Irán y esperan datos económicos
item.description: Las bolsas europeas se mantuvieron estables este lunes, mientras los mercados seguían de cerca la evolución de la situación entre Estados Unidos e Irán y se preparaban para una semana repleta de datos económicos que podrían ofrecer nuevas pistas sobre la trayectoria de la política monetaria del Banco Central Europeo.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas se mantuvieron estables este lunes, mientras los mercados seguían de cerca la evolución de la situación entre Estados Unidos e Irán y se preparaban para una semana repleta de datos económicos que podrían ofrecer nuevas pistas sobre la trayectoria de la política monetaria del Banco Central Europeo. Los inversores se preparaban para conocer los detalles de unas posibles sanciones secundarias más duras de Estados Unidos contra países con vínculos comerciales con Irán, cuyo anuncio se espera por parte del secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent. Por otra parte, el jefe del Ejército de Pakistán se encuentra en Teherán para intentar que Irán vuelva a la mesa de negociaciones. "En estos momentos hay muchas incógnitas en torno a esto (las sanciones)", afirmó Chris Beauchamp, analista jefe de mercados de IG Group. "Si se da una situación en la que la medida de Estados Unidos se interpreta como una amenaza para la economía iraní y esta responde de la única forma que puede, tomando medidas en el estrecho de Ormuz, sería especialmente negativo para los mercados europeos". El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) cerró sin cambios, en 654,21 puntos. La amenaza de sanciones se suma a los temores de una inflación prolongada que se apoderaron de los mercados mundiales la semana pasada, cuando los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos alcanzaron su máximo en varias décadas, en medio de las persistentes tensiones en Oriente Medio que han mantenido elevados los precios del petróleo. Entre los sectores, las acciones de viajes y ocio, que consumen mucha energía (.SXTP) , lideraron las subidas, con un alza del 1,7%, mientras que el crudo Brent bajaba un 1,9%. Las acciones de los medios de comunicación (.SXPP) y de los bienes personales y para el hogar (.SXQP) subieron un 1,4%. El índice de referencia STOXX 600 ha retrocedido en las últimas semanas tras alcanzar máximos históricos a principios de este mes, en un repunte impulsado por los resultados empresariales, mientras las preocupaciones por la inflación han pasado a primer plano. Los mercados monetarios están descontando una política más restrictiva por parte del Banco Central Europeo, apostando por que las tensiones geopolíticas podrían mantener elevadas las presiones sobre los precios e impulsar el tipo de depósito hasta cerca del 3% a finales de 2027.

item.title: FIA appeal court to have final say on Gasly's Monaco GP podium
item.description: Formula One's international court of appeal will meet in Paris on Tuesday to decide once and for all who finished third in the Monaco Grand Prix, more than two months after the event.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Formula One's international court of appeal will meet in Paris on Tuesday to decide once and for all who finished third in the Monaco Grand Prix, more than two months after the event. Alpine's Pierre Gasly finished third in the Mediterranean principality on June 7 but was [USN:L1N42F05I TEXT:"demoted to seventh"] when two five-second penalties for pit-lane speeding were applied by stewards post-race, with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar promoted to third and spraying the champagne. That decision was [USN:L6N42K0N7 TEXT:"overturned on June 12"], after stewards accepted Renault-owned Alpine's evidence that there had been a timekeeping error and removed the penalties, with Hadjar [USN:L6N42X114 TEXT:"handing the trophy back"] to Gasly. With some paddock insiders warning that the verdict [USN:L6N42L04D TEXT:"opened a can of worms"], McLaren and Red Bull [USN:L6N42O0YF TEXT:"appealed to the international court "]on June 16. McLaren took issue after Oscar Piastri, who dropped from fourth to fifth following Gasly's reinstatement, took penalties during the race for the same offence under the assumption it was unavoidable even though he was sure he had not been speeding. Unlike Gasly, who did not serve his penalties during the race and had time added on that could be removed, Piastri had no recourse with the time lost in the pits also having a knock-on effect on how the Australian raced after that. Team boss Andrea Stella said at the weekend's [USN:L6N44K04A TEXT:"Dutch Grand Prix"], won by McLaren's Lando Norris, that the appeal had a double intent. "We think that the process that happened after the race in Monaco needs to be reviewed because from a (standpoint of) fairness for all competitors, the fact that the penalty was removed introduces some significant elements of concern," he said. "The second aspect is the interest of McLaren. We got also materially penalised for having served a penalty that is not appealable and this even cost us points in the championship," added the Italian. "So there's a general interest for Formula One and the sport and the integrity of the sport, and there's a material interest for McLaren in terms of our championship impact." The FIA said the hearing, without public or media present for reasons of confidentiality, would be at the FIA headquarters with a decision published as soon as possible.

item.title: Trump comprou ações da SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, investiu até US$50.000 na SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho, mostrou declaração financeira pública, o que lhe conferiu participação financeira em uma importante empresa contratada pelo governo que é dirigida por um ex-assessor.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, investiu até US$50.000 na SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho, mostrou declaração financeira pública, o que lhe conferiu participação financeira em uma importante empresa contratada pelo governo que é dirigida por um ex-assessor. Ele comprou entre US$15.001 e US$50.000 em ações em 23 de junho, de acordo com uma declaração financeira assinada por ele em 12 de agosto, tornada pública em 22 de agosto. A compra fez parte de mais de 1.000 transações com ações realizadas pelo presidente em junho. A SpaceX realizou sua oferta pública inicial (IPO) em 12 de junho, batendo todos os recordes de IPO. Em comunicado à Reuters, o porta-voz da Casa Branca, Davis Ingle, afirmou que instituições financeiras terceirizadas administram de forma independente a carteira do presidente e replicam “índices reconhecidos, como o Schwab 1000”. “Nem o presidente Trump nem qualquer membro de sua família tem qualquer capacidade de orientar, influenciar ou dar sugestões sobre como a carteira é investida ou quando os investimentos são comprados ou vendidos”, disse Ingle no comunicado. O investimento de Trump na SpaceX cria um novo vínculo financeiro entre o presidente e a empresa de foguetes de Musk, em um momento em que o governo analisa decisões que podem afetar o futuro da empresa. A SpaceX é uma contratada das Forças Armadas dos EUA e frequentemente busca aprovações de órgãos federais. Na última quinta-feira, Trump instruiu sua equipe a aumentar drasticamente o número de lançamentos espaciais comerciais dos EUA. A SpaceX é uma empresa dominante nesse setor. A Reuters não conseguiu determinar imediatamente o valor exato do investimento, pois as autoridades federais utilizam faixas de valores para declarar o valor de seus ativos nos formulários de declaração financeira.

item.title: Durigan defende controle da “pejotização” e revisão de tributos de empresas em novo mandato de Lula
item.description: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta segunda-feira que sua equipe avalia mecanismos de controle da chamada “pejotização” em um eventual novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para minimizar o déficit previdenciário do país, defendendo também uma revisão de tributos cobrados hoje de empresas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta segunda-feira que sua equipe avalia mecanismos de controle da chamada “pejotização” em um eventual novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para minimizar o déficit previdenciário do país, defendendo também uma revisão de tributos cobrados hoje de empresas. Em entrevista ao Broadcast, da Agência Estado, Durigan afirmou que poderia haver uma regra relacionada ao percentual de contratos de pessoa jurídica (PJ) feitos por uma empresa em detrimento dos contratos CLT. “Uma empresa que tem 80% da sua força de trabalho pejotizada, eventualmente você pode ter que obrigar essa empresa a ter uma contribuição previdenciária para nivelar e poder oferecer a esses 80% dos seus trabalhadores um futuro um pouco mais protegido do ponto de vista de seguridade social”, afirmou. Durigan afirmou ser preciso reconhecer que o país tem um “déficit previdenciário importante”, ressaltando a necessidade de combater privilégios. Ele usou como exemplo a previdência de militares, que já foi alvo de proposta de ajuste pelo atual governo, mas o projeto não foi aprovado pelo Congresso. O ministro se pronunciou na entrevista como representante da campanha do presidente Lula, que buscará a reeleição no pleito de outubro. Sem entrar em detalhes, Durigan também disse que é “preciso fazer uma revisão da tributação empresarial, seja discutindo a tributação da folha de pagamento, seja discutindo a tributação do chamado JCP (Juros sobre o Capital Próprio).” Ele ainda defendeu a introdução de mecanismos que priorizem a contribuição tributária efetiva de empresas, não a nominal. “Não importa qual regime você vai estar, você tem uma contribuição efetiva que, via de regra, é muito menor do que a contribuição nominal que já está prevista na lei, de modo a otimizar e racionalizar o sistema tributário”, afirmou.

item.title: Mike McCarthy: Steelers at contract 'impasse' with CB Joey Porter Jr.
item.description: While eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey came off the physically unable to perform list on Monday, another Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback remains on the PUP list with no end to that stint in sight.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: While eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey came off the physically unable to perform list on Monday, another Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback remains on the PUP list with no end to that stint in sight. Steelers coach Mike McCarthy told reporters that the team is currently "at an impasse" with cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who is sidelined after aggravating a back injury on the first day of Pittsburgh's training camp. Porter, 26, is entering the final year of his rookie contract after the Steelers took him with the first pick of the second round (32nd overall) in the 2023 NFL Draft. Before sustaining the injury setback, Porter was present at the team's OTA and mandatory minicamp workouts but was not observed participating during the portions media members were allowed to observe. Asked for a timeline of when he would want to see Porter on the practice field in order to play him in the Steelers' regular-season opener vs. Atlanta on Sept. 13, McCarthy didn't give a specific answer, instead deferring to the uniqueness of this situation. "I learned this in my early years as a head coach: You have to separate the business and football," McCarthy said. "Sometimes it's easier than others. This is a challenge for both Joey and us because we're first-year staff. We've seen them play, compete against Joey. "I would love the opportunity to coach Joey Porter. I know our defensive guys would love the opportunity. So, we're at an impasse right here, and you've got to respect that. Every one of us has a contract. The organization, they have beliefs and so forth. But yeah, that's just kind of where we are." Porter has amassed 165 tackles, 31 pass breakups, three interceptions, three tackles for loss and one sack over 47 regular-season games (41 starts) over his first three seasons with Pittsburgh. --Field Level Media

item.title: Putin autoriza Rússia a assumir controle de infraestruturas consideradas vulneráveis a ataques de drones
item.description: O presidente Vladimir Putin concedeu, nesta segunda-feira, ao Estado russo o poder de assumir o controle de infraestruturas de importância crítica, caso se considere que elas estejam mal protegidas contra ataques de drones ucranianos e outras ameaças.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Vladimir Putin concedeu, nesta segunda-feira, ao Estado russo o poder de assumir o controle de infraestruturas de importância crítica, caso se considere que elas estejam mal protegidas contra ataques de drones ucranianos e outras ameaças. Os poderes especiais, estabelecidos em um decreto presidencial, permitirão que o Estado assuma a administração temporária dessas instalações, em um momento em que a Ucrânia intensificou os ataques com drones a refinarias de petróleo e depósitos de varejo. O Estado poderá assumir o controle de ativos físicos e financeiros, bem como dos direitos formais de propriedade, caso se determine que as entidades responsáveis por tais instalações tenham falhado em seu dever de protegê-las e demorem demais para repará-las após qualquer ataque, de acordo com o decreto. Isso se aplica a instalações de combustível, energia, indústria, comunicações, transporte e logística, bem como a outros objetos considerados de importância crítica para garantir a segurança e a estabilidade econômica do Estado e da população. O primeiro vice-primeiro-ministro, Denis Manturov, afirmou que a medida não deve ser vista como um precursor da nacionalização e não será utilizada em grande escala. “Isso não envolve nacionalização nem mudança de propriedade. O decreto prevê que o Estado participe da gestão de uma empresa a fim de resolver questões específicas de segurança”, disse Manturov, segundo a Interfax. Na semana passada, Putin ordenou que o governo lançasse um programa para reconstruir depósitos comerciais danificados ou destruídos pela Ucrânia nas últimas semanas. Desde 18 de julho, Kiev atacou pelo menos duas dúzias de depósitos pertencentes à Wildberries, a maior varejista online da Rússia, destruindo grande parte de sua capacidade de armazenamento. Na segunda-feira, a Ozon , segunda maior varejista online da Rússia, informou que quatro de seus centros logísticos no sul da Rússia foram alvo de ataques ucranianos.

item.title: Sky to shift focus toward future in matchup against Sun
item.description: The Chicago Sky were eliminated from postseason contention in their most recent game, but not without a fight until running out of gas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Sky were eliminated from postseason contention in their most recent game, but not without a fight until running out of gas. After seeing their three-game winning streak come to a halt, the Sky (15-23) will look to get back on track Tuesday when they visit the Connecticut Sun (9-27) in Uncasville, Conn. Natasha Cloud scored 16 points in Chicago's 113-90 setback to the Indiana Fever on Sunday. She also got into a heated verbal exchange with Enes Kanter Freedom that led to the former NBA player being ejected from a courtside seat. Azura Stevens had 14 points and rookie Aicha Coulibaly added 12 on 5-of-5 shooting from the floor. "I don't think anybody in the locker room is ready to mail it in," Sky head coach Tyler Marsh said. "We all understand we got a job to do. We got an organization and city to continue to play for. We got a lot of young players that still have time to continue to develop. We're not just playing for the right now, we're playing for the future too." Kamilla Cardoso, who boasts team-best averages in points (14.7) and rebounds (8.8), contributed 16 and 14, respectively, in Chicago's 92-63 loss at Connecticut on June 22. She added 26 points in the Sky's 94-88 victory over the Sun on July 30. Connecticut fell for the ninth time in its last 11 games on Saturday with a 77-68 setback to the Los Angeles Sparks. The Sparks scored 32 points in the first quarter then shifted to a defensive mindset, much to the chagrin of Connecticut head coach Rachid Meziane. "I didn't really like how our starting five came out tonight," Meziane said. "We didn't start the game with the right defensive energy. ... Yeah, I was a little surprised because the last five games we really (started well)." Saniya Rivers had 14 points and matched a career high with four steals for the Sun, who were held to 35.1% shooting but did force 25 turnovers that led to 30 points. Connecticut's Brittney Griner has missed four consecutive contests due to a left knee injury. She posted team-high point totals in two of the three meetings versus Chicago. --Field Level Media

item.title: Law firm Paul Weiss taps new Supreme Court practice head after Shanmugam exit
item.description: Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year. Jay, who has argued 19 cases before the U.S. Supreme Court, joins Paul Weiss as a Washington, D.C.-based partner, the firm said on Monday. He has represented clients including Teva Pharmaceuticals, Varsity Brands and B&B Hardware. Shanmugam, who previously led the Supreme Court practice at Paul Weiss, [USN:L6N4161HM TEXT:"departed"] with Masha Hansford in April to launch a new practice at law firm Davis Polk. Jay practiced at Goodwin for 14 years. He previously worked as an assistant to the Solicitor General. Earlier in his career he was a clerk to former U.S. Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia. Jay told Reuters that he was eager to join Paul Weiss as the New York firm grows its litigation department. Paul Weiss has hired a handful of litigation partners this year, including former U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission deputy enforcement director Antonia Apps in February. The firm has also seen litigator departures, including a pair of partners who joined Linklaters in July.

item.title: US include 35-year-old rookie Duncan among Solheim Cup captain's picks
item.description: U.S. Solheim Cup skipper Angela Stanford leaned heavily on experience by naming Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as her three captain's picks on Monday for the team that will look to retain the trophy they took from Europe two years ago.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. Solheim Cup skipper Angela Stanford leaned heavily on experience by naming Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as her three captain's picks on Monday for the team that will look to retain the trophy they took from Europe two years ago. Khang will be competing in her fifth consecutive Solheim Cup, Zhang will wear the red, white and blue for a third time while Duncan, at 35 the oldest member in the squad, is making her debut in the biennial matchplay competition. "Nothing can compare to the Solheim Cup ... putting on the red, white and blue is such an honor," Khang, who was top scorer for the U.S. at the 2023 Solheim Cup in Spain, said after being announced as the first of three captain's picks. Duncan, who joins Auston Kim as one of two rookies on the U.S. team, had held the second qualifying spot via the world rankings for nearly two months before dropping out of position after The Standard Portland Classic in mid-August. In addition to being the oldest member on the team, Duncan is the oldest debutant since Nancy Scranton played her first match aged 39 in 2000. Zhang had arguably one of the most dominant performances in the history of the Solheim Cup in 2024 when she went 4-0-0 in matches that never made it to the 17th hole. The trio joined automatic qualifiers Nelly Korda, Angel Yin, Jennifer Kupcho, Yealimi Noh, Auston Kim, Lauren Coughlin, Allisen Corpuz, Andrea Lee and Alison Lee on the U.S. team for the September 11 to 13 event at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands. The U.S. squad are looking to retain the Solheim Cup and secure their first away victory since the 2015 edition.

item.title: Wisconsin high school QB dies from injuries sustained in game
item.description: A high school quarterback in Wisconsin died following injuries sustained during a game, according to the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A high school quarterback in Wisconsin died following injuries sustained during a game, according to the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel. Adam Massman, a senior at Lincoln High School in Alma Center, Wis., died after a game Thursday against Turtle Lake, per the report. District superintendent Drew Semingson sent a letter to Lincoln HS families informing them of the tragedy. "Adam was active in our Lincoln community, participating in multiple sports, clubs, and activities making friends everywhere he went," Semingson said in the statement. "This loss touches our Lincoln family in many ways. Adam's family has deep connections throughout our schools." Emergency personnel were on site at the game and Massman was taken to the hospital. Semingson did not provide any details about the nature of the injuries. The school will be open Monday and Tuesday to students, parents and friends wishing to meet with counselors. Massman also played varsity baseball and basketball at Lincoln. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cheniere confirms Corpus Christi LNG plant undergoing maintenance
item.description: U.S. LNG producer Cheniere Energy's Corpus Christi LNG export plant in Texas continued to show reduced natural gas demand on Monday, according to preliminary data from financial firm LSEG, as maintenance work at the facility continues.
item.dc:creator: Curtis Williams
item.content:encoded: U.S. LNG producer Cheniere Energy's (LNG.N) Corpus Christi LNG export plant in Texas continued to show reduced natural gas demand on Monday, according to preliminary data from financial firm LSEG, as maintenance work at the facility continues. Corpus Christi was on track to consume about 1.8 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd) of natural gas, down from its typical intake of around 2.6 bcfd. Corpus Christi is the United States' third-largest LNG export facility, while Cheniere is the largest LNG exporter. Cheniere said its Corpus Christi plant was undergoing planned maintenance but declined to give further details. Feedgas deliveries to all U.S. LNG export plants totaled about 16.7 bcfd on Monday, below the nearly 18 bcfd the country's LNG facilities can process. The U.S. is the world's largest LNG exporter and a key supplier of the supercooled fuel to global markets. The reduction in feedgas flows comes as global LNG markets remain supported by supply concerns linked to the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

item.title: Playboy fights fee bid in dispute with ex-lawyers at Quinn Emanuel
item.description: Playboy Enterprises and Quinn Emanuel are locked in a dispute over unpaid legal fees after Playboy accused the U.S. law firm of mishandling litigation and ignoring conflicts of interest while representing the adult entertainment company.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Playboy Enterprises and Quinn Emanuel are locked in a dispute over unpaid legal fees after Playboy accused the U.S. law firm of mishandling litigation and ignoring conflicts of interest while representing the adult entertainment company. Playboy sued the law firm in Los Angeles Superior Court last week, asking a judge to halt an arbitration proceeding in which Quinn Emanuel is seeking legal fees it claims it is owed by Playboy from litigation over its iconic "bunny" logo. The clash over fees stems from Quinn Emanuel's prior work for Playboy in a lawsuit that alleged sexual wellness company Advanced Vita Supplements infringed the company's bunny trademarks. Playboy claims Quinn Emanuel improperly steered the company away from naming additional defendants in the case because they were clients of the firm. Playboy argued in its August 18 filing that the arbitration should be paused until after a trial that is scheduled for March 2027 in the trademark case. The resolution of the trial, Playboy said, could affect its claims against the law firm. Quinn Emanuel "wants to force the issue of its fees before its own malpractice can be adjudicated — which is inherently unfair," Playboy said. The company said the law firm "routinely boasts on social media that it produced more than $2 billion in revenue last year; it does not urgently need another $700,000." Quinn Emanuel had no immediate comment on Monday. Playboy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Quinn Emanuel is not a defendant in the underlying lawsuit. Quinn Emanuel in March initiated an arbitration proceeding seeking to recover about $712,000 in unpaid fees for its work on the Advanced Vita Supplements case. It represented Playboy in the case until 2024, when the company fired the firm and hired lawyers from law firm Frost. Playboy said it has already paid Quinn Emanuel more than $4.5 million and will show the firm "was massively overpaid for the work it actually performed." Quinn Emanuel has denied any wrongdoing, and argued that the fee arbitration is separate from Playboy's conflict-of-interest claims and should proceed. The firm in court filings has said its fees and costs billed to Playboy were reasonable. The case is Playboy Enterprises Inc v. Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan, Los Angeles Superior Court, No. For plaintiff: Christopher Frost and Catherine Liu of Frost For defendant: Dylan Byrd and Grant Maxwell of Quinn Emanuel Read more: [USN:L6N43M0XG TEXT:"Short seller Muddy Waters says Quinn Emanuel betrayed client loyalty in Techtronic lawsuit"] [USN:L6N43G0DZ TEXT:"Law firm Quinn Emanuel barred from antitrust case over client conflict"] [USN:L6N41W1BU TEXT:"Judge sanctions law firm Quinn Emanuel, citing ethical lapses"] [USN:L1N3QT0BK TEXT:"From Harvard to Musk, law firm Quinn Emanuel juggles Trump's friends and foes"] [USN:L2N3PG052 TEXT:"Want to hire Elon Musk's lawyer? That will be $3,000 an hour"]

item.title: Fire loan D Christopher Cupps to Scottish club
item.description: The Chicago Fire loaned homegrown defender Christopher Cupps to Scotland's Greenock Morton FC on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Fire loaned homegrown defender Christopher Cupps to Scotland's Greenock Morton FC on Monday. The loan runs through the end of 2026, with Chicago retaining the right to recall the teenager at any point. "We are excited to see Christopher continue to develop during the rest of the year in a new and challenging environment," Fire sporting director Gregg Broughton said. "He has a very high potential and promising future at the Chicago Fire and has stepped up to every challenge he has faced so far. Playing competitive matches during the rest of the year will only help him mature as a player and as a person." Cupps, 18, has appeared in six matches (three starts) for the Fire over the past two seasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senegal keeper Diaw joins Al Shabab
item.description: Senegal goalkeeper Mory Diaw has joined Al Shabab from Ligue 1 side Le Havre on a one-year deal, the Saudi Pro League club announced on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Senegal goalkeeper Mory Diaw has joined Al Shabab from Ligue 1 side Le Havre on a one-year deal, the Saudi Pro League club announced on Monday. The 33-year-old started this year's World Cup on the bench but came on as a substitute when Edouard Mendy was injured in Senegal's group match against Norway. He then played against Iraq and in the 3-2 defeat by Belgium in the round of 32. The PSG academy product made 30 appearances in Ligue 1 last season and has won eight caps. Al Shabab, who signed Ghana's [USN:L4N44I0TC TEXT:"Thomas Partey"] on a free transfer during the close season, have yet to register a win in the SPL after two games.

item.title: Saudi Aramco signs agreements worth over $3.7 billion with French companies
item.description: World's top oil exporter Saudi Aramco has signed agreements with some French companies potentially worth over $3.7 billion in total, it said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World's top oil exporter Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) has signed agreements with some French companies potentially worth over $3.7 billion in total, it said on Monday. The agreements include procurement deals for drilling equipment and oil country tubular goods, as well as a memorandum of understanding to explore industrial AI and related technologies. The company did not identify the French companies involved in the agreements.

item.title: Rubio tells S.Korean counterpart their countries need to remain in close coordination
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted the need for the United States and South Korea to remain in close coordination on matters integral to their alliance in a call with his counterpart on Monday, the State Department said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted the need for the United States and South Korea to remain in close coordination on matters integral to their alliance in a call with his counterpart on Monday, the State Department said. Rubio and South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun discussed a range of issues in the alliance, State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott added in a statement.

item.title: Hyundai Motor's union reaches tentative wage deal with management, Yonhap reports
item.description: Hyundai Motor's South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hyundai Motor's (005380.KS) South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday. The deal comes after the union [USN:L1N44I02F TEXT:"staged its first full strike"] in a decade on Friday after wage talks stalled, as it sought a higher retirement age and job protections against artificial intelligence and automation. According to the Yonhap report, the tentative agreement includes a base salary increase plus a performance bonus and welfare points. From next year until 2028, 500 new technical workers will be hired, the report added. Hyundai Motor did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. Production at Hyundai's largest automobile factory in Ulsan city would have been suspended if the two sides had not reached a deal. The Ulsan plant has an annual capacity to produce about 1.5 million vehicles, accounting for roughly a quarter of Hyundai's total output. The union had demanded the company set aside 30% of net income for bonuses and guarantee job security, raising concerns over growing adoption of robotics and artificial intelligence on assembly lines. The world's third-largest automaker, which is also developing [USN:L1N43I027 TEXT:"humanoid robots"], appears to be planning to replace human workers with new technologies, a union leader said. "We already see lots of robots deployed in the factories," Kim Jin-wook, head of external relations for Hyundai's union, told Reuters. "We are demanding management increase new hires, as the company is trying to reduce headcounts." ($1 = 1,382.8900 won)

item.title: Aneel nega perícia pedida por Enel SP e fala em "desrespeito" da empresa à regulação
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) negou nesta segunda-feira uma perícia pedida pela distribuidora Enel São Paulo no processo de caducidade da concessão, julgando a medida como desnecessária e classificando o posicionamento da empresa como "desrespeitoso" à regulação brasileira.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) negou nesta segunda-feira uma perícia pedida pela distribuidora Enel São Paulo no processo de caducidade da concessão, julgando a medida como desnecessária e classificando o posicionamento da empresa como "desrespeitoso" à regulação brasileira. A italiana Enel (ENEI.MI) havia solicitado uma [USN:L1N41R0US TEXT:"perícia para sanar controvérsias"] com a área técnica da Aneel que apareceram no processo de caducidade, entendendo que a avaliação de um terceiro sobre dados metodológicos, estatísticos e outros seria "indispensável" para garantir a imparcialidade de uma decisão do órgão. Em seu voto, aprovado por unanimidade, a diretora relatora, Agnes da Costa, disse que a perícia só seria necessária caso houvesse algum fato relevante que não estivesse suficientemente esclarecido no processo, que pode culminar na perda do contrato pela Enel São Paulo. Costa afirmou ainda que a argumentação da Enel a favor da perícia traz "conclusões preocupantes", pois denota ou um "desconhecimento profundo" do funcionamento e competência legais da Aneel, ou desconsidera deliberadamente o modelo brasileiro de regulação do setor elétrico. "O posicionamento da concessionária não só é desrespeitoso como também se defronta com o arcabouço normativo do país", disse a diretora, acrescentando ainda que a postura adotada pela Enel sugere uma tentativa de retardar o fim do processo administrativo. O diretor-geral da Aneel, Sandoval Feitosa, também ressaltou a especialização técnica da agência reguladora e observou que, em uma eventual judicialização do caso, o juiz poderia solicitar a produção de prova pericial. "A Aneel, no ano em que faz 30 anos, ter suas competências legais sendo questionadas, e um pouco além, questionar a isenção e a imparcialidade do regulador brasileiro... é, no mínimo, inadequado", afirmou Feitosa. Procurada, a Enel afirmou que "não questiona a independência, a competência ou as atribuições legais da Aneel". Segundo a empresa, seu pedido de perícia visa "aprofundar a análise de aspectos técnicos complexos, como a excepcionalidade do evento climático de dezembro de 2025, seus efeitos sobre a infraestrutura elétrica e a aplicação de critérios ainda não regulamentados para eventos dessa natureza". O processo que trata da caducidade da concessão da Enel São Paulo entra agora na etapa final, após o regulador já ter [USN:L1N4480Y6 TEXT:"negado um recurso da empresa"]. A Enel tem dez dias para apresentar alegações finais, antes de o colegiado da Aneel decidir sobre a recomendação de caducidade ao Ministério de Minas e Energia. A Enel buscou anteriormente afastar a avaliação da Aneel de que a concessionária apresentou falhas estruturais na prestação dos serviços aos consumidores e no restabelecimento da energia após eventos climáticos que deixaram milhões sem luz.

item.title: Ex-Bengals TE CJ Uzomah retires after 10 seasons
item.description: Tight end C.J. Uzomah announced his retirement Monday after 10 NFL seasons.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tight end C.J. Uzomah announced his retirement Monday after 10 NFL seasons. He played his first seven seasons (2015-21) with the Cincinnati Bengals, who drafted him in the fifth round in 2015. Uzomah, 33, played two seasons with the New York Jets (2022-23) and appeared in seven regular-season games with the Super Bowl champion Philadelphia Eagles in 2024 before sitting out the 2025 campaign. "Retiring in Stripes," the Bengals posted on X, along with the words "Bengal Forever." Uzomah thanked the Bengals in a post on X. "History has a way of repeating itself and there's no place I'd want to formally announce my retirement, than the place that started it all for me and gave me my chance," he wrote. "The place I will always think of as my second home and will always hold a special place in me and my family's heart. The place where we won a playoff game for the first time since before I was born, and went on an odds defying run to the Super Bowl. A place I've met people who have become like brothers to me. Cincinnati, thank you for everything. Who Dey Forever." Uzomah caught 192 passes for 1,881 yards and 16 touchdowns in 113 career games (85 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump compró en junio acciones de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según declaración patrimonial
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, invirtió en junio hasta 50.000 dólares en SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según una declaración financiera pública, lo que le otorga una participación financiera en una importante empresa contratista del Gobierno dirigida por su antiguo asesor.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, invirtió en junio hasta 50.000 dólares en SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según una declaración financiera pública, lo que le otorga una participación financiera en una importante empresa contratista del Gobierno dirigida por su antiguo asesor. Adquirió acciones por un valor de entre 15.001 y 50.000 dólares el 23 de junio, según una declaración financiera firmada por él el 12 de agosto y hecha pública el 22 de agosto. La compra formaba parte de las más de 1.000 operaciones bursátiles que el presidente realizó en junio. SpaceX salió a bolsa el 12 de junio, batiendo todos los récords de salidas a bolsa. En una declaración a Reuters, el portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Davis Ingle, afirmó que instituciones financieras independientes gestionan la cartera del presidente y replican "índices reconocidos, como el Schwab 1000". "Ni el presidente Trump ni ningún miembro de su familia tiene capacidad alguna para dirigir, influir o aportar ideas sobre cómo se invierte la cartera o cuándo se compran o venden las inversiones", afirmó Ingle en el comunicado. La inversión de Trump en SpaceX añade un nuevo vínculo financiero entre el presidente y la empresa de cohetes de Musk, en un momento en el que la Administración está tomando decisiones que podrían afectar al futuro de la empresa. SpaceX es un contratista del ejército estadounidense y a menudo solicita autorizaciones a agencias federales. El jueves, Trump ordenó a su equipo que ayudara a aumentar drásticamente el número de lanzamientos espaciales comerciales de Estados Unidos. SpaceX es una empresa dominante en ese sector. Reuters no pudo determinar de inmediato el importe exacto de la inversión, ya que los funcionarios federales utilizan rangos para declarar el valor de sus activos en sus declaraciones patrimoniales.

item.title: 米国、新たな対イラン制裁措置を発表－取引続ければ他国も標的に
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランを世界経済から孤立させる「前例のない」取り組みを開始すると発表し、イランと取引を続ける国は米国の制裁対象となる恐れがあると警告した。
ベッセント氏はワシントンで開いた記者会見で、「われわれは世界各地に広がるイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な猛攻撃を開始する」と表明。「イラン政権を経済的に窒息させるものだ」とし、イラン資金の洗浄に関与する場合、ドルへのアクセスを遮断すると述べた。
また、トランプ米大統領が各国首脳に電話し、「イラン政権との関係を停止するよう具体的に要請している」とも説明。各国にはイランとの経済協力を打ち切るための明確な期限が設定されており、従わなければ米財務省が単独で措置を講じる考えを示した。
原題：Bessent Unveils Plan to Sever Iran Access to Global Economy

item.title: 米、対イラン二次制裁を拡大 財務長官「経済的生命線断つ」
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米トランプ政権は２４日、新たな対イラン経済制裁を発表し、イランとのビジネス関係を維持する国や団体に対する二次制裁の対象を拡大した。イランとの戦争が約６カ月に及ぶ中、イランへの経済的圧力を強化する考えだ。一方で、二次制裁の対象となる国や発効時期などの詳細については明言を避けた。

ベセント財務長官は記者会見で、イランに対する「経済版Ｄデー」と呼ぶ措置について説明。「われわれは世界中のイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な総攻撃を開始する」と表明し、「イラン政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断ち切ることが目的だ」と述べた。

さらに、米財務省はイランが石油の密輸や制裁回避に利用しているネットワークや仲介者、資金ルートを特定しており、米政府はパートナー国と協力し、イランの「違法な収入源」を全て標的にすると言明した。

米財務省の声明によると、イラン政府が経済を支えるために利用しているデジタル資産、テクノロジー、金、航空、海運の5分野が新たに二次制裁の対象に追加された。さらに、核、ミサイル、サイバー活動、石油取引などに絡み、約６０の団体、個人、船舶が制裁対象に指定された。

ベセント長官は「イランを支援する全ての国は、米国の制裁措置に直面する覚悟をしておくべきだ」と警告。しかし、イランの石油取引を助長した疑いのある中国の金融機関は今回の制裁対象に含まれていない。

中国はここ数年、イラン産原油の最大の購入国となっている。米国は中国による購入の抑制に向けた取り組みを強化しているものの、現時点では中国の大手銀行を制裁対象に指定するには至っていない。

item.title: US removes Syria from terrorism sponsor list, lifting major investment obstacle
item.description: The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government.
item.dc:creator: Feras Dalatey
item.content:encoded: The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government. The removal, posted on the U.S. Treasury's website, took effect after a 45-day congressional review period triggered when Trump formally notified Congress on July 8 of his intention to rescind the designation. “These actions were all taken in recognition of the positive actions taken and further commitments by the Syrian government under President Ahmed al-Sharaa to fully distance Syria from acts of international terrorism,” U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani [USN:L8N44J06U TEXT:"told Reuters"] on Saturday that the government hoped removing what he called the "last obstacle" would help reconnect Syria to the global financial and economic system and boost investment. "There is no longer any obstacle to investment, doing business and rebuilding economic life in Syria," he said. Syria had been on the list since 1979, when Washington accused the government of former President Hafez al-Assad of supporting militant groups. The designation remained throughout the rule of his son Bashar al-Assad, who was toppled by rebels led by current President Ahmed al-Sharaa in December 2024. CUBA, IRAN, NORTH KOREA REMAIN Monday's announcement also removed the designation of the Nusrah Front as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist organization, leaving Cuba, Iran and North Korea as the three countries designated by Washington as state sponsors of terrorism. The designation carries restrictions on U.S. foreign assistance, defense exports and sales, certain dual-use items and financial transactions, and had remained a major deterrent for banks and investors even after Washington dismantled its broader sanctions program on Syria. Trump's administration terminated comprehensive U.S. sanctions on Syria in July 2025, while maintaining targeted sanctions against Assad and his associates, rights abusers, drug traffickers, Islamic State and al Qaeda affiliates and Iranian proxies. The U.S. Treasury has since said American financial institutions can provide services to Syria, process payments involving Syrian banks and establish correspondent banking relationships with them, provided sanctioned parties are not involved. But the terrorism designation remained a source of legal and compliance risk for firms considering entering Syria, whose government is seeking billions of dollars in investment to rebuild after nearly 14 years of war. Signs of interest had grown ahead of the removal. Syria's finance ministry said this month that Finance Minister Mohammad Yisr Barnieh held talks with Bank of America (BAC.N) executives over potential cooperation and Syria's reintegration into the international financial system. Bank officials expressed willingness to visit Syria and continue discussions, according to the ministry. Mastercard (MA.N) has gone further, announcing in May that it was working with QNB Group (QNBK.QA) and Syria's central bank to prepare infrastructure for international card payments in the country. The company has described itself as an early investor in Syria and said it wants to help connect Syrian consumers and businesses to global payment networks. CONTINUED COOPERATION Trump notified Congress of his decision after meeting Sharaa in Ankara in July, telling the Syrian president in a letter seen by Reuters that he [USN:S0N3Y802F TEXT:"had promised"] to "remove all barriers" preventing Syria from rebuilding. The delisting also followed months of negotiations between Damascus and Washington over Syria's economic and foreign policy. Reuters [USN:L6N43U0ZX TEXT:"reported"] this month that Damascus agreed to drastically reduce imports of Russian oil during discussions with Washington over lifting the terrorism designation, according to three sources familiar with the talks. Trump has increasingly embraced Sharaa, the former commander of al Qaeda's Nusra Front who broke ties with the global jihadist network in 2016 and led the rebel coalition that overthrew Assad. Washington has praised cooperation by Sharaa's government against Islamic State and said easing restrictions is intended to give Syria an opportunity to stabilise, attract investment and rebuild.

item.title: Trump bought shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, financial disclosure shows
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser. He bought between $15,001 and $50,000 in shares on June 23, according to a financial disclosure signed by him on August 12 and made public on August 22. The purchase was part of more than 1,000 stock trades the president made in June. SpaceX [USN:L6N42G18Z TEXT:"priced"] the biggest-ever U.S. IPO on June 12, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at $1.77 trillion. In a statement to Reuters, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000." "Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold," Ingle said in the statement. Trump's investment in SpaceX adds a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. SpaceX is a U.S. military [USN:L1N3P10ZT TEXT:"contractor,"] and often seeks [USN:L1N43U12L TEXT:"approvals"] from federal agencies. Trump on Thursday [USN:S0N3ZQ02C TEXT:"directed"] his team to help drastically increase the number of U.S. commercial space launches. SpaceX is a dominant player in that sector. U.S. Small Business Administration leader and Trump cabinet member Kelly Loeffler earned millions from SpaceX's IPO, Reuters previously [USN:L6N43H172 TEXT:"reported"]. Loeffler first invested in xAI, Musk’s AI and social media firm that has since [USN:L4N3YY1U7 TEXT:"merged"] with SpaceX. She invested again after Trump nominated her to lead the SBA. Her first investment in xAI would have been worth between $7 million and $2.6 billion on the day of the IPO, depending on the exact amount she invested and the date she made it, said Franco Granda, analyst at data provider PitchBook. The second investment would have been worth between $2.2 million and $25.4 million that day, he said. Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of Trump's investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms.

item.title: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia killed in South Sudan ambush
item.description: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said. Among the injured were three U.N. peacekeepers, two police officers from South Sudan and two civilian staff members, U.N. spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a press briefing. He said the attack was carried out by unidentified gunmen and the patrol appeared to have been deliberately targeted. "These are part of regular patrols that the U.N. has been doing in trying to help the constant insecurity in the area," Dujarric said. The U.N. has called on relevant authorities for a thorough and prompt investigation to ensure all those responsible are brought to justice, Dujarric said. He stressed that "attacks against U.N. peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law." The latest violence "brings to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in malicious acts since January 1 of this year," he added. Attacks on U.N. personnel are rare but not unprecedented in South Sudan, where U.N. patrols operate in volatile areas affected by intercommunal fighting, armed youth mobilizations and clashes involving government forces. In June, the U.N. Security Council adopted a resolution aimed at [USN:L1N42U11Y TEXT:"strengthening accountability for attacks on U.N. peacekeepers"], amid concern over rising violence and low prosecution rates. That followed a series of incidents targeting U.N. personnel, including the [USN:L1N42C0PN TEXT:"killing of seven peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon"] after a fresh round of fighting broke out between Israel and Hezbollah in early March.

item.title: Italy regulator clears Ludoil's acquisition of Sicilian oil refiner
item.description: Italy's competition authority has cleared the acquisition of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's competition authority has cleared the [USN:L8N41Q1HU TEXT:"acquisition"] of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity. Ludoil agreed in May to buy 51% of ISAB from Cypriot private equity fund G.O.I. Energy, subject to several conditions. The antitrust regulator said that the transaction would not hamper competition in the Italian market for refined products in a significant way, adding it would not open a full investigation on the acquisition. The refiner is linked to an exclusive long-term contract with global commodity trader Trafigura until 2033, the watchdog said in its document, revealing interesting details regarding its business. The supply and offtake agreement commits ISAB to sell approximately 90% of its refined petroleum products to Trafigura while Trafigura supplies ISAB with crude oil and the other raw materials required for refining, the competition authority said.

item.title: Israeli fire kills two young children in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said. Medics and relatives said 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater was hit by a bullet in her back while she was eating inside her family's tent in the enclave's southern city of Khan Younis. The fire came from Israeli forces to the east, they added. The Israeli military said it was not aware of any incident involving a 10-year-old girl. A four-year-old boy and another Palestinian were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes on a house in Bureij refugee camp and a road in Khan Younis, medics said. Earlier on Monday, another Israeli airstrike killed one person and wounded another at a tent in Deir Al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, medics said. The Israeli military said that strike in Deir Al-Balah targeted a Hamas militant, but did not specifically respond to questions about the other two reported attacks in Khan Younis and Bureij. More than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a ceasefire took effect last October , according to Gazan health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed. Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement a broader plan by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament. Israel says its strikes aimed to thwart imminent attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants. The Israeli military issued two separate evacuation orders in Beach refugee camp and Deir Al-Balah in northern and central Gaza Strip before it carried out airstrikes in the two areas, without reports of casualties, residents and medics said. It also bombed a desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in Gaza City, at a time when the enclave is suffering water shortages, residents and Hamas said. An Israeli military spokesperson said the military had carried out strikes on several Hamas weapons storage sites throughout the day, including two inside mosques. The spokesperson said that among the sites targeted on Monday was one located adjacent to a desalination facility. The spokesperson said the military had not targeted the desalination facility and did not say whether or not it had been damaged in the strike.

item.title: UK, Ukraine sign AI defence partnership linked to battlefield technology
item.description: The deal will focus on AI-enabled battlefield sensors, low-power chips for drones, and other defence technologies.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

UK, Ukraine sign AI defence partnership linked to battlefield technology

The deal will focus on AI-enabled battlefield sensors, low-power chips for drones, and other defence technologies.

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham delivers a speech next to Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during the Coalition of the Willing meeting, in Kyiv, Ukraine Aug 24, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Henry Nicholls)

FAST

LONDON: Britain said on Monday (Aug 24) it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems. Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy signed the agreement in Kyiv, making Britain the first international partner to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, a government statement said. Avengers Labs was built around an annotated dataset of 5 million battlefield images, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said earlier in August, largely drawn from the military's DELTA combat system - a domestically developed battlefield management and situational-awareness system. The platform uses data collected from cameras and sensors across Ukraine's battlefield, including information on tanks, artillery systems, drones and other military targets.

The Ukrainian ministry said AI models trained on the data were already being used in an automated target-detection system that analyses more than 100,000 drone video feeds each month and can identify about 70 per cent of enemy targets in real time. Under the deal, Britain and Ukraine will collaborate on pilot projects including technology that uses fibre-optic cables as AI-enabled sensors to help protect military facilities, and research into low-power AI chips for drones and autonomous systems. The British government said the partnership would initially focus on defence and national security projects bringing together researchers, engineers, technology companies and military experts from both countries. Burnham on Monday visited Ukraine for his first trip abroad since becoming prime minister, where he had talks with Zelenskyy and co-chaired a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing." His office had earlier announced Britain would allow missile maker MBDA to release classified information on British-made components used in the SCALP long-range cruise missile to help establish assembly lines in Ukraine.

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、同盟国に防衛費不足270億ユーロの補填要請 防空支援強化も
item.description: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ　２４日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２４日、冬を前にロシアがエネルギー関連インフラへの攻撃を再び強化するとみられる中、同盟国に対して防空関連の支援パッケージを供与するよう要請した。キーウで開かれたウクライナを支援する「有志連合」の会合で述べた。

また、ゼレンスキー氏は２０２６年のウクライナの防衛部門に必要な資金の不足分２７０億ユーロを補うため、パートナー国に協力を求めた。

さらに、欧州各国の管轄下で凍結されているロシア資産について、同盟国に改めて言及し、凍結されたロシア資産を資金不足の一部補填に活用することを提案した。

FAST

Aug 24 : Iraq's Australian coach Graham Arnold has renewed his contract with the team until 2027, the country's FA said on Monday. After weeks of speculation, the IFA made the announcement at a press conference attended by the 63-year-old, confirming he would remain in charge through the Gulf Cup in Saudi Arabia in September, as well as the Asian Cup early next year. "I have renewed my contract for six months and this decision is in my best interest and in the best interest of the Iraq national team, although the association offered me a four-year extension," Arnold was quoted as saying by the Iraqi News Agency. Arnold guided Iraq to this year's World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, ending a 40-year absence from the tournament. However, Iraq exited at the group stage after losing all of their Group I matches against Norway, France and Senegal.

item.title: 中国国家主席、7年ぶりインド訪問へ ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議に大規模代表団
item.description:
Saurabh Sharma Aftab Ahmed
[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席が、９月にインドで開催される新興国グループ「ＢＲＩＣＳ」首脳会議に大規模な代表団を率いて出席する見通しだと、関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば７年ぶりの訪問となり、中国とインドの関係改善につながる可能性がある。

ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議は９月１２、１３両日にニューデリーで開催。２０２０年の両国国境付近での衝突を受けて悪化した関係の修復につながるかどうかが注目される。トランプ米政権の通商政策を踏まえ、ＢＲＩＣＳ諸国の経済への悪影響を抑えたい意向とみられる。

インド関係者の１人はロイターに「中国当局者は、宿泊や警備体制の最終調整をしている」と述べた。関係者２人によると、約４００人の中国当局者が同行する見通し。１９年の前回訪問時は２００人未満だった。

関係者らによると、両国の当局者らは首脳による協議で、国境や地域の安全保障問題を巡る長年の対立を調整しつつ、関係拡大へ向けた方法を模索するとみられる。習氏の最終的な訪問計画や二国間会談に関する議題などは未確定という。

インドのモディ首相は昨年、７年ぶりに中国を訪問したものの、両国関係に大きな改善は見られていない。インドのアジト・ドバル国家安全保障顧問は２４日から訪中し、王毅外相と国境問題に関して協議する見通しだ。

中国外務省は「今年のＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議が成功するよう支援する」とした上で、習氏の訪問に関して「現時点で提供できる情報はない」と述べた。２５年にブラジルで開かれた前回のＢＲＩＣＳサミットでは、習氏は出席を見送っていた。

item.title: China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years
item.description: India-China relations have remained strained for years, largely due to ongoing border tensions and territorial disputes.
