China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years

India-China relations have remained strained for years, largely due to ongoing border tensions and territorial disputes.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, on Oct 23, 2024. (Photo: REUTERS/China Daily)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation , three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals. India is hosting the Sep 12 to 13 summit, where Xi 's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020 . "Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the India n sources with direct knowledge told Reuters. Last year, India n Prime Minister Narendra Modi visit ed China for the first time in seven years , but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides.

Two other India n sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019. Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added. Xi 's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised , the sources said. The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India , the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit." "We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi 's visit , it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil. India 's foreign ministry did not comment.

INDIA -CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas. Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 India n and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024. But on Aug 12, India said peace along the border was critical to ties after reports that India n and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border. India 's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday (Aug 24) started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue. While India and China remain competitors, US President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi 's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS.

item.title: メキシコが2年ぶりにサムライ債の発行計画、最大6本－関係者
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： メキシコは今週、2024年以来2年ぶりとなるサムライ債の発行を計画している。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

関係者によると、メキシコは年限3.5－20年の円建て債を最大6本発行する方向で調整している。28日に条件決定を予定しており、需要や市場環境によっては一部の年限の発行を見送る可能性がある。債券の初期価格交渉では、年限に応じてTONARミッドスワップに100－200ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上乗せした水準になる見通しだという。

メキシコ政府が前回サムライ債を発行したのは2024年8月で、5本発行し計1522億円を調達した。メキシコは1年半－2年おきにサムライ債を発行しており、今回もこれまでの発行ペースに沿ったものとなる。

メキシコの信用格付けには下押し圧力がかかっている。S&Pグローバル・レーティングは5月、財政状況の低迷が長引いていることや債務水準の上昇、経済成長の弱さを理由に、メキシコの格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」に変更した。ムーディーズ・レーティングスも5月に同様の懸念を示し、メキシコの格付けを投資適格級で最低の水準に引き下げた。国営のメキシコ石油公社（ペメックス）への継続的な支援が、政府の債務抑制能力を制約しているとしている。

メキシコは通商面でも不安定な状況にある。米国は7月、カナダ、メキシコとの米国・メキシコ・カナダ協定（USMCA）を更新せず、代わりに毎年見直す方針を示した。

その後、米国とカナダの交渉は21日に決裂した。合意案の文言が、カナダ側が合意したと認識していた内容と食い違う点が複数あったためだ。このため、メキシコと米国の協議の行方にも懸念が生じている。

FAST

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus wants his team to turn the hurt of their weekend defeat by New Zealand into fuel to get themselves back into contention in the four-test series. The Springboks lost their top world ranking when New Zealand won the opening test 33-16 at Ellis Park on Saturday, outscoring their hosts five tries to one as they saw off South Africa’s efforts to muscle them into submission. The world champions had been favourites before the start of the first test of the Kiwis’ eight-match tour. "One could see the hurt on everyone’s faces after Saturday’s match, and we know what we have to do to bounce back strongly this week," Erasmus said as he announced the line-up for the second test in Cape Town on Saturday.

"There were a handful of positives and negatives last week, but the main thing that let us down was that we created so many chances, but mistakes at crucial times cost us," Erasmus told reporters on Monday. "We are angry with each other. The coaches did and said stupid things. The players did stupid things on the pitch," added Erasmus. "Me personally, I made wrong calls on some of the tactics we wanted to try and do inside their 22. It didn’t work and that’s on me." Erasmus went back to naming his side early, but kept the All Blacks guessing by putting flanker Siya Kolisi back in the side if the inspirational captain proves his fitness. If not, Paul de Villiers will stay in the starting line-up. "Paul played well on Saturday, and there’s no reason why we should keep him out, but Siya is our captain," the coach said. "Siya has got some strengths, one of them being the attacking breakdown, he’s really good at sorting that out for us, which was the area we struggled with. "There were lots of times that we played badly, not because they did anything illegal, but we couldn’t get the ball away out of the breakdown when we were in really good attacking positions. Siya’s really good at that," Erasmus added.

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town; Editing by Ed Osmond)

item.title: Gang attack on hillside town near Haiti's capital leaves 30 dead
item.description: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday. Kenscoff is a hillside town overlooking Port-au-Prince has seen frequent gang attacks over the last couple of years. Rights groups have reported mass killings, rapes, arson and kidnappings, forcing thousands to flee their homes. Haitian rights group RNDDH estimated 30 to 40 people had been killed and 15 to 20 wounded in the overnight raid, which began around 10:30 p.m. local time (0230 GMT), but warned it was still difficult to assess a complete tally. Haiti's prime minister's office on Monday afternoon decried the "heinous attack", noting all security forces were on high alert and reinforcements were being deployed. "Kenscoff will not be abandoned," it said in a statement. "The government's authority will be restored, without weakness and without delay, throughout all of Kenscoff." Haiti's national police did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The community occupies a strategic position overlooking routes into Petion-Ville - home to several embassies, upscale hotels and the temporary seat of government - as well as routes from the capital into southern parts of the country. Local media said several houses were set on fire, including the home of Jean William Pape, a leading public health expert in Haiti. The attack occurred as the U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force, which is mandated to help police fight gangs and replace an underfunded and ineffectual predecessor, plans to reach a full capacity of more than 5,500 troops by fall this year.

item.title: 49ers owner Jed York pleads no contest after arrest in Ohio
item.description: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution. In a plea deal entered Monday, prosecutors amended the original charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. According to reports, the criminal tool in York's possession was believed to be a cell phone used to reply to a prostitution advertisement. York, 46, was arrested in East Palestine. Court documents indicate agents for the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force intercepted communication in which York responded to a prostitution website. York, like other NFL owners, is subject to the league's personal conduct policy. The NFL had not commented on the matter as of Monday afternoon. As part of the reduced charges, York was sentenced to one day in the Columbiana County Jail for each count. He was credited with time served Sunday and paid a fine of $1,150, according to court records. York, a native of Youngstown, Ohio, has been CEO of the 49ers since December 2008 and the team's principal owner since 2024. --Field Level Media

item.description: TOKYO, Aug 25 : Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding

FAST

TOKYO, Aug 25 : Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said. The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding non-core businesses and redeploying capital into growth areas, in what could become one of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's most significant initiatives to advance corporate governance reform. Under the plan, roughly 30 per cent corporate tax on gains from sales of non-core businesses would be deferred indefinitely, provided companies reinvest the proceeds within several years in acquisitions aligned with their core operations and commit to investing in those businesses, one of the sources said. The proposal is expected to be submitted as part of tax reform requests due at the end of this month, with details to be worked out before a final tax reform package for the next fiscal year is approved at year-end, said one of the sources, who declined to be identified as the matter is still private.

POOR CAPITAL ALLOCATION The initiative is modelled on Germany's tax reform in the early 2000s, which largely exempted corporations from taxes on gains from share disposals, helping dismantle the country's dense network of cross-shareholdings and making it easier for companies to reshape their business portfolios. Non-core businesses often remain trapped within sprawling Japanese conglomerates because gains from divestitures are taxed, reducing the incentive to transfer assets to owners better positioned to extract value from them. The result is often inefficient capital allocation. A recent government study found that about 65 per cent of Japanese companies' invested capital remains tied up in businesses that fail to earn their cost of capital, largely offsetting value created by higher-performing units. Such capital trapped in low-return operations is seen as limiting growth investment and weighing on long-term corporate value. Japan has already introduced a range of measures to promote business overhauls over the years, including spin-off tax rules in 2017 and a partial spin-off regime in 2023, but business divestitures taking advantage of those rules have remained relatively limited. A 2020 industry ministry report showed Japanese companies often lack clear divestment criteria and have traditionally prioritised maintaining group size, employment and corporate stability over portfolio reshaping. The tax reform, if implemented, is likely to boost already sizzling M&A activity in Japan. Deal activity involving Japanese companies last year more than doubled from the previous year to a record $353 billion, according to LSEG. Divestitures of Japanese businesses accounted for $44.7 billion of that total.

Explainer-What are Iran’s options to escalate further in face of US economic threats?

LONDON, Aug 24 – U.S. threats to impose “the toughest sanctions in history” to force Iran to buckle to its demands after nearly six months of war have raised the prospect of a new round of escalation in the Gulf.

How could Iran respond to the economic pressure?

CAN IRAN STOP MORE OIL GETTING OUT OF THE MIDDLE EAST?

Show Full Article

Mohsen Rezaei, the former Revolutionary Guards chief and secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, has already threatened to shut down oil exports — one of Tehran’s main strategic approaches since the war began on February 28.

“If the economic war continues, not a single drop of oil will be exported, neither through the Strait of Hormuz nor from anywhere in the Persian Gulf,” he said.

Iranian attacks and threats to shipping have already stopped most traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, largely shutting down a waterway that carried around a fifth of global energy before the conflict.

Although some oil tankers have been moving through the strait in recent weeks, volumes remain very low and on Sunday Iran blacklisted 45 tankers it says failed to comply with the rules it wants to impose on Hormuz shipping.

Missile, drone or speedboat attacks on tankers trying to leave the Gulf have repeatedly pushed up oil prices during the six months of the conflict.

Meanwhile, Tehran’s Houthi allies have restricted Red Sea shipping with attacks and threats to blockade all Saudi Arabian shipping, which carries crude to Asia through the Bab el-Mandeb strait past the group’s Yemeni stronghold.

While the attacks initially only stopped some vessels, with more than half still getting through in mid-August, the situation is difficult for shippers with Chinese shipping companies now rerouting away from Bab el-Mandeb, according to industry sources.

Further attacks, such as the one that targeted a vessel off the main Saudi Red Sea oil terminal at Yanbu on Monday or a drone strike near the Suez Canal in early August, could raise oil market anxiety levels and crude oil prices.

ARE GULF STATES STILL AT RISK OF IRANIAN ATTACK?

Iran has threatened to retaliate against any neighbours who take part in U.S. efforts to strangle the country’s economy with “earthquake” force.

It has targeted Gulf states and Jordan repeatedly during the war, mostly focusing on U.S. bases but also hitting energy infrastructure and other targets.

Any intensified attacks that targeted upstream oil or gas facilities could further drive up energy prices in ways that inflict political damage on the Trump administration and could be harder to reverse than attacks on shipping.

Targeting power and water desalination plants in the hot, parched region would also pose a major risk to U.S.-aligned Gulf monarchies that function as significant financial hubs for the global economy.

CAN IRAN ATTACK WESTERN COUNTRIES DIRECTLY?

While Western countries are beyond the range of Iran’s main munitions, the Revolutionary Guards have historically been willing to find alternative ways of attack.

On Monday, Britain said Iran-linked hackers had shut down a small electricity station while U.S. officials have said Tehran was likely behind cyber attacks on water plants in Minnesota. Iran has not commented on those allegations.

Western security services have also accused Iran of recruiting local people to stage attacks or attempt assassinations in the West. Iran has denied that.

(By Angus McDowall; Editing by Aidan Lewis)

FAST

Aug 24 : A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday. With 15 km (9.32 miles) remaining of the 174-km route from Gruissan to Font-Romeu, the skies darkened as the peloton neared the top of the Col de Mont-Louis and huge hailstones began bouncing off the tarmac and pelting the riders. Mats Wenzel (Kern Pharma) and Lorenzo Fortunato (XDS Astana) were 25 seconds ahead of the peloton when the elements intervened as race leader and favourite Tadej Pogacar was seen indicating to the peloton to pull off the course. Bedraggled riders were then seen getting off their bikes and shuffling into a hotel for shelter.

Shortly afterwards race organisers ASO announced the stage would not resume, leaving fans frustrated at the finish where thick layers of hail blanketed the road. Slovenia's Pogacar (UAE Emirates-XRG) retained his overall lead of nine seconds from Belgium's Wout van Aert (Dutch Visma-Lease a Bike) with Britain's Matt Brennan 10 seconds back. Earlier it had been warm and sunny on the flat approaches to the mountainous finish with no sign of the chaos to come as a five-man breakaway group stayed out ahead. Pogacar, bidding to complete his Grand Tour collection by winning the Vuelta for the first time, was always near the front of the pack with his team setting the pace. Sadly, his expected challenge for the stage victory fell foul of the weather in an anti-climactic finish. He will get his chance to underline his superiority again on Tuesday though with stage four featuring three first-category climbs as the race starts and finishes in Andorra la Vella.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米国が中国製品に7.5%関税へ､過剰生産能力で－9月の米中首脳会談前に
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国は中国の過剰生産能力を問題視し、中国製品に対して7.5%の関税を課す見通しだ。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにしたもので、来月予定されるトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席との会談を前に導入する方向だ。

今回の措置により、トランプ政権2期目に導入される対中関税は約20%に戻ることになる。これとは別に、トランプ政権1期目に導入され、バイデン政権下でも継続された関税も課されている。

匿名を条件に語った同関係者によれば、具体的な税率は最終決定されたわけではない。トランプ氏は通商政策の発表に関し、最終段階で新たな要求を突き付ける、あるいは内容を変更するといった手法を採ることで知られる。

検討されている案の一つは、より高い対中関税率を発表した上で、その適用を一部停止し、実効税率を7.5%にするものだという。

どの税率をどの程度の期間、適用停止とするか、詳細はなお協議中だと関係者は語った。

トランプ政権は今年3月、過剰生産能力を巡る懸念を理由に、1974年通商法301条に基づき、主要な貿易相手国・地域を対象に調査を開始した。

原題：US Eyes China Overcapacity Tariffs of 7.5% Before Xi-Trump Talks（抜粋）

item.title: 米トランプ政権、専門職ビザ手数料10万ドル超へ 規制案公表
item.description:
Daniel Wiessner
[２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は２４日、専門技能を持つ外国人労働者向け就労ビザ「Ｈ－１Ｂ」の申請手数料を約１０万ドルとする措置を法制化するための規制案を公表した。

トランプ大統領は昨年９月、移民取り締まり強化の一環として、同ビザの手数料引き上げに向けた大統領布告に署名。従来の手数料である約２０００─５０００ドルから１０万ドル超へと大幅に引き上げる内容。

ただ、連邦地裁は６月、議会の承認を得ていない違法な課税に当たるとして、無効とする判断を示し、その後控訴審での審理が続いている。

布告は９月に失効するものの、国土安全保障省に手数料増額を恒久化するための規則を制定するよう指示していた。

同省がオンライン官報に掲載した規制案によると、手数料は１０万３２６５ドルに引き上げられ、２５日に正式に公表される。その後、３０日間のパブリックコメント期間を経て、年末までに最終決定される可能性がある。

item.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
item.description: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season. "Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip." Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games. The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers. Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel. "Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said. Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns. Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation. Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games. Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception "It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on." Watson, who turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener, used time with the media Monday to walk back some of his views on Browns fans. "... I think my emotions got the best of me," Watson said. "My comments wasn't intended to go at any of the fans around the city, because there's been a lot of great fans that have been supporting me." Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response. "I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us." --Field Level Media

item.title: Rendimiento de bonos EEUU cae mientras el Tesoro evalúa un cambio en su política de recompra
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedieron.
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedieron. * La CNBC dio a conocer la noticia menos de una semana después de que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, anunciara que el Gobierno duplicará, como mínimo, sus recompras de deuda a largo plazo, una medida inesperada que avivó la especulación sobre un enfoque más intervencionista para frenar el aumento de los rendimientos. * Esta medida supondría un cambio de rumbo, ya que las recompras están pensadas para ser neutras en términos de efectivo y se han financiado mediante emisiones, según explicó Molly Brooks, de TD Securities. * Los operadores siguen sopesando las implicaciones, sobre todo porque la decisión se produjo al margen del calendario habitual de refinanciación del Tesoro. A algunos les preocupa que la medida sea contraproducente y socave la confianza en el enfoque "regular y predecible" de la agencia respecto a la emisión de deuda. * "Si seguimos viendo este tipo de titulares que indican que podrían estar acelerando un poco las cosas, esa naturaleza regular y predecible podría, de hecho, aumentar la prima de plazo de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo", señaló Brooks. * Bessent afirmó el lunes que Estados Unidos continuaría con su programa habitual de subastas de bonos del Tesoro. * Esta situación complica aún más las perspectivas sobre las tasas de interés, ya que varias autoridades monetarias de la Reserva Federal han abogado por alzas en medio de una inflación persistentemente elevada. * Los operadores de futuros sobre los fondos federales están valorando en un 44% la probabilidad de un alza de tasas en la reunión de política monetaria del banco central de septiembre, cifra que se eleva al 78% para diciembre. * El rendimiento de los bonos a dos años , que suele evolucionar en línea con las expectativas de tasas, cotizaba estable en el 4,234%, y el de las notas referenciales a 10 años perdía 3,99 puntos básicos, al 4,698%. * La curva de rendimiento entre la deuda a dos y 10 años se aplanaba a 46 puntos básicos.

item.title: 9月の相次ぐ社債発行、消化への懸念は行き過ぎ－JPモルガン
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資適格級社債市場では、9月に社債発行が相次ぐ見通しだ。JPモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ケルシー・ベロ氏は、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで、社債への旺盛な需要を踏まえれば、大量発行への懸念は行き過ぎの可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ベロ氏によると、9月の発行額については、1750億－2500億ドル（約27兆8400億－39兆7700億円）と幅広い予想が出ている。クレジットのポートフォリオマネジャーからは、発行額が2500億ドルに達しても「実際にはそれほど問題ではない」との声が聞かれるという。ただ、ベロ氏は、最終的な発行額を巡る不確実性が、市場関係者にとって事前の対応を難しくしていると指摘した。

市場では予想のばらつき自体が緊張の要因となっている。発行額予想の下限と上限には750億ドルの開きがあり、例年、社債発行が最も活発になる月の一つである9月を前に、ポートフォリオマネジャーはポジションを取りにくくなっている。

AIインフラ整備への支出を賄うため企業の借り入れが膨らむ中、社債発行は過去最速のペースが続いている。米国の優良企業による社債発行額は8月、3カ月連続で月間最高を更新した。

借り入れ急増の影響が表れる中、投資家は購入する債券やその価格を以前より厳しく選別するようになっている。データセンター事業の資金調達を目指す企業の中には、投資適格級の債券であっても、数十億ドルを調達するためにジャンク債投資家への依存を強めるところも出ている。

8月の社債発行額はすでに1570億ドルに達した。アルファベットによる250億ドルの起債に加え、アッヴィやアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）による大型案件が発行額を押し上げた。

ベロ氏は「記録的な供給がある一方、需要も過去最高となっている」と述べた。こうした需給関係により、9月の大量発行は懸念されるほど大きな問題にはならない可能性があるという。

FAST

LONDON, Aug 24 : England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday. "Following a referral from the ECB, the Cricket Regulator has confirmed that they will investigate events on Saturday night in Derby," the ECB said in a statement. "Brydon Carse will no longer be available for selection for the second men's test while this investigation is ongoing and the full facts are obtained." Carse, who did not play in the opening test victory at Headingley, will be replaced by Sonny Baker.

Videos circulated on social media appearing to show the 31-year-old Durham bowler in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers outside a venue. According to reports, Carse was not arrested and no charges were brought. It has been a busy summer for England's Cricket Regulator, the body set up to investigate matters where there is an allegation of a breach of the ECB's code of conduct. In June it concluded an investigation into former test captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Gus Atkinson after a nightclub incident following the first test against New Zealand. Both were left out of the second test before the Regulator ruled that there was insufficient evidence to establish that any regulatory breach occurred. The latest investigation comes five days after England's returning test captain Joe Root spoke of the players being "really good role models and human beings" following a series of incidents and accusations of a drinking culture. Controversy has followed England around in recent times with off-field issues during last winter’s tours, including Harry Brook being fined £30,000 ($41,000) following an altercation in Wellington as well as reports of drinking during a mid-Ashes series trip to Noosa. Stokes retired from international cricket after returning for the third test against New Zealand and Brendon McCullum was sacked as test coach.

item.title: フーシ派、サウジのヤンブー沖で船舶攻撃と発表 国営海運バハリも被弾確認
item.description: [カイロ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　２４日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海沿岸にあるヤンブー港沖で船舶を攻撃したと発表した。同派の軍事報道官ヤヒヤ・サリー氏がテレビ演説で明らかにした。

サウジアラビアの国営海運会社バハリも同日、自社の船舶「アムザン」が紅海で攻撃を受けたと声明で明らかにした。

これに先立ち、英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、ヤンブーの西方６３カイリの海域でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと発表。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、乗組員全員の安全が確認されており、環境への影響も報告されていないという。

ヤンブーはサウジの主要な紅海沿岸の石油積み出し港で、１日あたり数百万バレルの石油が積み出されている。また、イランが封鎖しているホルムズ海峡を迂回するサウジ産原油の主要な輸出ルートとなっている。

FAST

GLASGOW, Aug 24 : Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court. Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010. The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals. He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month.

Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010. He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

item.title: Peso argentino toca nivel mínimo histórico
item.description: El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario anotó el lunes su nivel mínimo histórico, con aval del Gobierno, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario anotó el lunes su nivel mínimo histórico, con aval del Gobierno, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta. Los analistas coinciden en que es saludable la tendencia ya que hay un consenso generalizado de cierto atraso cambiario, en un país donde el dólar se usa como ahorro ante el resguardo inflacionario. Por su parte, las plazas de acciones y bonos del país sudamericano registraron mejoras dispares luego de finalizar en baja la semana previa ante la clara postura de prudencia por parte de los inversores. En el segmento mayorista , el peso nacional se depreció un 0,66% al nivel mínimo histórico en 1.510 por cada dólar, luego de cerrar la semana anterior en 1.500 unidades. "El dólar mayorista quebró la barrera de los 1.500 (pesos) porque contenerlo a medida que pasa el tiempo exige esfuerzos mayores en términos de comprar menos reservas y subir tasas", dijo a Reuters Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero. "Así, subas graduales del dólar van a permitir que no se atrase, facilitando la acumulación de reservas y no agregando estrés en las tasas. La clave será que no tenga ningún componente anunciado o sistemático, porque ello daría incentivos a dolarizar como ocurre cuando hay un 'crawling peg' formal", agregó. El banco central (BCRA) argentino acumuló compras por 11 millones de dólares con el inicio de esta semana. Hasta la semana anterior, en "agosto las compras (del BCRA) acumulan 466 millones de dólares, un promedio de 33 millones de dólares diarios que profundiza la desaceleración frente a julio (103 millones diarios) y queda por debajo de junio (68 millones de dólares) y mayo (137 millones de dólares)", explicó el agente de compensación y liquidación Cohen. El índice S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires mejoró un firme 2,81% al cierre, apoyado por el avance de acciones del rubro financiero, contra una caída del 1,2% la semana previa. "Pese al freno del deterioro reciente, el mercado mantiene la cautela ante la duda de si este movimiento constituye una mejora de fondo o un mero rebote técnico", expresó la consultora Wise Capital. En tanto, los bonos soberanos en el segmento extrabursátil mejoraron apenas un 0,1% promedio, tras finalizar con un retroceso de 1,8% la semana pasada. El riesgo país, elaborado por el banco JP. Morgan, retrocedía algunos escalones hasta los 503 puntos básicos (2000 GMT). El llamado Índice de Confianza en el Gobierno (ICG) de la Universidad Torcuato Di Tella subió 2,4 puntos porcentuales a 41,2% en agosto, marcando la mayor mejora mensual desde noviembre. "La confianza en el Gobierno (del libertario Javier Milei) se mantiene elevada en relación a otras presidencias de este siglo", dijo el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. "La confianza en el Gobierno es clave por su correlación con los resultados electorales para el oficialismo", acotó.

item.title: 米国、対イラン追加制裁を発表へ－財務長官「経済的生命線全て断つ」
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランに対する新たな経済制裁措置を発表する見通しだ。約6カ月に及ぶ戦争の終結を目指し、米政府は軍事攻撃の威嚇から、徹底した経済制裁による圧力強化へと軸足を移す。

ベッセント氏は予定している会見で、イランを一段と効果的に孤立させる計画の詳細を明らかにする。米国は数十年にわたり広範な対イラン制裁を科してきたが、今回さらに強化する。具体的な内容は不明だが、中国やトルコ、インドなどイランの主要貿易相手国の一部に影響が及ぶ可能性がある。

アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）は先週、イランとの経済関係を全て断絶したと発表。湾岸の米同盟国によるこうした動きが、ワシントンの戦略を後押ししている。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「世界は、イランが孤立するまで、この圧政政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断つことがわれわれの目的だと理解すべきだ」と述べた。

イラン経済は既に極めて厳しい状況にあり、米海軍による海上封鎖で重要な原油輸出が大幅に制限されている。

イランでは年間インフレ率が80％を超え、人口9000万人の国民への圧力が一段と強まっている。イラン通貨リアルは対ドルで過去最安値に沈む。トランプ米大統領が先週、イランへの経済圧力を強める計画を明らかにして以降、4.5％下落した。

イランはこれまでも制裁をしのいできた経緯があり、米国の今回の措置が新たな軍事攻撃を招く恐れもある。イランは、米国の制裁計画を支援する国には報復すると警告した。2月下旬の戦争開始以降、イランは湾岸の米同盟国に数千発のミサイルやドローンを撃ち込んでいる。

イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は23日夜、「米国によるイラン国民への経済戦争に参加したり、これを支援したりする国の行為を戦争行為とみなす」とXへの投稿で表明。

その上で、「ホルムズ海峡からも、ペルシャ湾のどこからも、原油は一滴たりとも輸出されなくなる」と述べた。

item.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq caen presionados por acciones tecnológicas; inversores analizan medidas sobre Irán
item.description: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendieron el lunes, lastrados por las acciones tecnológicas, mientras los inversores sopesaban la nueva presión económica estadounidense contra Irán, a la espera esta semana de los resultados del gigante de la IA Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Saeed Azhar, Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendieron el lunes, lastrados por las acciones tecnológicas, mientras los inversores sopesaban la nueva presión económica estadounidense contra Irán, a la espera esta semana de los resultados del gigante de la IA Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación. * El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una posible ampliación de las sanciones a los países que mantienen relaciones comerciales con Irán, en lo que denominó un "Día D económico", pero no llegó a imponer sanciones. * Las acciones de semiconductores cayeron, arrastrando al índice de semiconductores de Filadelfia (.SOX) . Nvidia (NVDA.O) bajó, al igual que Micron Technology (MU.O) y Broadcom (AVGO.O) , presionando al índice de tecnología de la información del S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) . * El sentimiento hacia las empresas tecnológicas también se vio afectado por la creciente oposición política a los centros de datos de IA. * El gobernador de Texas, Greg Abbott, lanzó una de las advertencias más contundentes hasta la fecha por parte de un republicano a la industria de la IA, afirmando que las firmas de centros de datos "cavaron su propia tumba" y merecen el rechazo que enfrentan tras no lograr el apoyo de la comunidad, informó Axios el domingo. * Sin embargo, el índice financiero (.SPSY) subió, con JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) y Visa (V.N) al alza. También contribuyeron a mantener a flote al índice Dow Jones. * Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 21,37 puntos, o un 0,28%, a 7.653,00 unidades. El Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajó 200,80 puntos, o un 0,77%, a 25.979,66 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) subió 141,67 puntos, o un 0,27%, a 53.418,68 unidades. * Se espera que los resultados trimestrales del gigante de la IA, Nvidia, sean otro catalizador clave para los mercados. Cualquier señal de desaceleración del crecimiento podría reavivar la preocupación por las elevadas valoraciones. * Los mercados también estarán atentos al informe de Gastos de Consumo Personal, el indicador de inflación preferido de la Fed, que se publicará el miércoles.

item.title: ＩＥＡ、戦略石油備蓄の2回目の放出「当面協議せず」＝事務局長
item.description:
Nora Buli
[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー） ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nora Buli

[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　２４日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２１日、戦略石油備蓄の追加放出については現時点で協議していないとロイターに述べた。

ビロル氏はノルウェーで開かれたエネルギー会議の合間に、ＩＥＡが戦略石油備蓄の２回目の放出について検討しているかとの質問に対し、「当面は検討していない」と言及。ＩＥＡは市場を「非常に注意深く」注視し続けており、３月に行った４億バレルの放出後も戦略備蓄の８０％が残っていると明らかにした。

天然ガスに関しては、透明性プラットフォーム「ＡＧＳＩ」のデータで欧州の現在のガス備蓄水準が約６２％にとどまっていることに懸念を表明。「備蓄は過去の平均を下回っており、われわれは依然として中東からのガス供給に期待している。同時に欧州はロシア産ガスの輸入停止を約束している」とし、「欧州に厳しい冬が訪れた場合、いくつかの課題に直面する可能性がある」と述べた。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）は１２月１日までに備蓄率を８０％まで引き上げることを目標としている。

item.title: トランプ氏、対カナダ自動車・鉄鋼関税を50％へ 来年1月発動
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、２０２７年１月１日から、カナダ産の自動車やトラック、自動車部品、鉄鋼に対する関税を５０％に引き上げると表明した。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「米国で製造すれば関税はゼロだ」とした上で、「貿易面でもその他の面でも、カナダは世界で最も扱いにくい国の一つだ。彼らは当然の権利があるかのように振る舞うが、われわれはカナダを必要としていない。カナダこそが米国を必要としているのだ」と投稿した。

さらに、通商交渉決裂後にカナダ当局者らが行った一連の発言に言及し、カナダ側が「従わない」のであれば、カナダにとって結果はさらに悪化するとの認識を示した。

米国は２２日、カナダとの通商交渉が決裂したことを受け、約２００億ドル相当のカナダ製品に対する５０％の追加関税を発動した。

交渉では、カナダ産の自動車・小型トラックに対する最高関税率を２５％から１５％に、アルミニウムと鉄鋼への関税を５０％から２５％にそれぞれ引き下げる見通しとなっていた。しかし、中・大型トラックに対する米関税の引き下げが争点となり、合意に至らなかったという。

カナダのカーニー首相は報復措置として、９月８日から米国産の鉄鋼や電子機器などに関税を課す方針を表明した。

カーニー氏は２４日、トランプ大統領による今回の新たな関税措置の表明について「米国が何らかの報復措置を取ることは驚きではない」と述べた。先週、交渉が決裂したが、米国と互恵的な合意は可能だとし、「米国がカナダの産業に対して正しい姿勢を持てば、カナダは交渉のテーブルに戻る」と述べた。

米自動車産業はカナダやメキシコとのサプライチェーン統合が進んでおり、関税措置は内容次第で米国内の自動車生産に深刻な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

カナダ自動車部品製造業者協会（ＡＰＭＡ）のフラビオ・ボルペ会長は、米国が検討する関税について「その負担は米国の自動車組立メーカーが負うことになる。こうした部品がなければ、全米の自動車組立工場は操業停止に追い込まれるだろう」と警鐘を鳴らした。

こうした中、バンス副大統領はメーン州での演説で、カナダとの交渉は継続しており、米国は貿易における公平性を求めていくと言明。「カナダは土壇場で理不尽な要求を次々と突きつけてきた」と非難した上で、「合意は必要だが、カナダ首相には明確なメッセージを送る必要がある。メーン州の人々を、そして米国を食い物にするのはやめてもらいたい。われわれは貿易政策において公平さを求める」と述べた。

ベセント米財務長官も同日、記者団に対し、トランプ大統領はカナダに交渉のテーブルに戻り、誠意を持って交渉に臨むことを望んでいると語った。

主要自動車メーカーはトランプ大統領の発表について直ちにはコメントしていない。

トランプ大統領の警告を受け、２４日の米株式市場で自動車株は大きく下落した。フォードは３．６％安、ステランティスは４．２％安、ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は１．６％安となった。ニューヨーク市場でトヨタ自動車は１．５％安、ホンダは２．１％安となった。

item.title: As US border reopens to Mexican cattle, concerns persist over screwworm spread
item.description: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening. Mexican Agriculture Minister Columba Lopez said authorities would reinforce the dispersal of sterile flies in Sonora and Chihuahua, a key eradication strategy aimed at preventing the parasite from reproducing. The phased reopening marks the first easing of a U.S. ban imposed more than a year ago to keep out the flesh-eating pest, with imports set [USN:FWN43Q0OT TEXT:"to resume"] initially through Arizona before expanding to additional ports in New Mexico. The plan has drawn criticism from some U.S. cattle groups and state officials who argue that resuming imports could increase screwworm risks even as the parasite continues to spread in northern Mexico and has already been detected in Texas and New Mexico. The USDA previously said the reopening would proceed in phases and remain contingent on Mexico's compliance with screwworm-control measures. A USDA website on Monday said it reopened the Douglas, Arizona, port to cattle imports from Mexico "guided by overlapping safeguards and a science-based import protocol" agreed upon by the two countries. The USDA will next evaluate the reopening of ports in Santa Teresa and Columbus, New Mexico to cattle, bison, and horses. "The opening of ports may be paused if USDA identifies increased risk in Sonora or Chihuahua via post-opening audits or other observations/information," the site said. Chihuahua, one of Mexico's most important cattle-exporting states, has reported 183 confirmed screwworm cases since detecting its first case in July, while neighboring Sonora state has reported two confirmed cases after announcing its first detection last week. Sonora has activated emergency surveillance and containment protocols, while Chihuahua has intensified inspections, livestock movement controls and treatment campaigns to prevent further spread. The sterile insect technique works by releasing millions of sterilized screwworm flies that mate with wild females but produce no offspring, gradually driving down the pest population. Mexico recently opened a sterile-fly production plant in Chiapas, while the United States is building its own production facility in Texas, expected to be completed by [USN:L6N4470WS TEXT:"spring of 2027"]. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum referred to the sterile fly technique as a "modern" and "effective" way to fight screwworm. "That allows us to open the border," Sheibaum said in her daily press conference.

item.title: A medida que la frontera de EEUU vuelve a abrirse al ganado mexicano, persiste preocupación por propagación del gusano barrenador
item.description: México está reforzando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha intensificado los controles sobre las exportaciones de ganado tras la reanudación del comercio transfronterizo el lunes, en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: México está reforzando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha intensificado los controles sobre las exportaciones de ganado tras la reanudación del comercio transfronterizo el lunes, en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos. La secretaria de Agricultura de México, Columba López, afirmó que las autoridades reforzarían la liberación de moscas estériles en Sonora y Chihuahua, una estrategia clave de erradicación destinada a impedir que el parásito se reproduzca. "Vamos a mantener nosotros todo el sistema de trazabilidad desde la nacencia hasta que coloquemos el ganado del otro lado", dijo López en un enlace desde Sonora a la conferencia de prensa matutina de la presidente Claudia Sheinbaum. "Y la otra parte es reforzar la dispersión de moscas (vamos a) mantener muchísimos controles de seguridad", añadió. La reapertura gradual supone la primera flexibilización de[USN:L6N43Q1B0 TEXT:" la prohibición impuesta"] por Estados Unidos hace más de un año para impedir la entrada de esta plaga carnívora; está previsto que las importaciones se reanuden inicialmente a través de Arizona, antes de ampliarse a otros puertos de Nuevo México. El plan ha suscitado críticas por parte de algunas asociaciones ganaderas estadounidenses y de funcionarios estatales, que argumentan que la reanudación de las importaciones podría aumentar el riesgo de la mosca, incluso cuando el parásito sigue propagándose en el norte de México y ya se ha detectado en Texas y Nuevo México. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA por su sigla en inglés) había indicado anteriormente que la reapertura se llevaría a cabo por fases y que seguiría dependiendo del cumplimiento por parte de México de las medidas de control de la mosca del gusano. El lunes, la página en internet del USDA informó de que se había reabierto el puerto de Douglas, en Arizona, a las importaciones de ganado procedente de México, "guiándose por medidas de seguridad complementarias y un protocolo de importación con base científica" acordado por ambos países. El USDA evaluará la reapertura de los puertos de Santa Teresa y Columbus, en Nuevo México, al ganado vacuno, los bisontes y los caballos. "La apertura de los puertos podría suspenderse si el USDA detecta un aumento del riesgo en Sonora o Chihuahua a través de auditorías posteriores a la apertura u otras observaciones o información", indicó en el sitio. Chihuahua, uno de los estados mexicanos más importantes en la exportación de ganado, ha notificado 183 casos confirmados de gusano barrenador desde que detectó su primer caso en julio, mientras que el vecino estado Sonora ha notificado dos casos confirmados tras anunciar su primera detección la semana pasada. Sonora ha activado protocolos de vigilancia y contención de emergencia, mientras que Chihuahua ha intensificado las inspecciones, los controles de movimiento de ganado y las campañas de tratamiento para evitar una mayor propagación. La técnica de insectos estériles consiste en liberar millones de moscas esterilizadas que se aparean con hembras silvestres pero no producen descendencia, lo que reduce gradualmente la población de la plaga. México ha inaugurado recientemente una planta de producción de moscas estériles en Chiapas, mientras que Estados Unidos está construyendo su propia instalación de producción en Texas, cuya finalización está prevista para la primavera de 2027. La presidenta Sheinbaum se refirió a la técnica de la mosca estéril como una forma "moderna" y "eficaz" de combatir al gusano barrenador. "Eso nos permite que se abra la frontera", afirmó la mandataria en su rueda de prensa.

item.title: EEUU anuncia "Día D económico" contra Irán con ampliación de sanciones secundarias
item.description: El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una ampliación de las sanciones secundarias que puede imponer a entidades y países que mantienen vínculos comerciales con Irán en todo el mundo, mientras intensifica significativamente la presión económica sobre Teherán a medida que la guerra se acerca a su sexto mes.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder, Humeyra Pamuk
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una ampliación de las sanciones secundarias que puede imponer a entidades y países que mantienen vínculos comerciales con Irán en todo el mundo, mientras intensifica significativamente la presión económica sobre Teherán a medida que la guerra se acerca a su sexto mes. En una conferencia de prensa, el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, presentó lo que describió como un "Día D económico", con el objetivo de dar una advertencia final a los países para que rompan sus vínculos comerciales con Irán o se arriesguen a que empresas y entidades clave queden excluidas del sistema financiero basado en el dólar. "Estamos lanzando una ofensiva económica contra las conexiones financieras de Irán en todo el mundo. Nuestro objetivo es cortar todo el sustento económico que sostiene a este régimen tiránico hasta que Teherán se quede solo", declaró Bessent. El Departamento del Tesoro ha mapeado las redes, los facilitadores y los canales financieros que Irán utiliza para el contrabando de petróleo y la evasión de sanciones, y afirmó que Washington trabajará con sus socios para atacar cualquier fuente de "ingresos ilícitos" de Irán. El Departamento de Estado anunció que ha emitido resoluciones contra cinco sectores -activos digitales, tecnología, oro, aviación y transporte marítimo- que el gobierno iraní utiliza para apuntalar su economía. El Tesoro también ha impuesto sanciones a casi 60 entidades, personas y buques. Durante varios años, China ha sido el mayor comprador de petróleo iraní, y Washington ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para restringir las compras chinas, aunque hasta el momento no ha designado a los grandes bancos chinos que podrían estar facilitando el comercio de petróleo. La guerra de Trump con Irán, que ha disparado los precios de la energía a nivel mundial, está a punto de cumplir seis meses. Si bien los intensos combates han disminuido, los esfuerzos diplomáticos para poner fin a la guerra se han estancado y el transporte de petróleo y materias primas a través del estrecho de Ormuz permanece bloqueado, lo que mantiene elevados los precios de la energía. El índice de aprobación de Trump ha caído a mínimos históricos, y solo el 33% de los estadounidenses aprueba su gestión, según la última encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos. El mandatario afirma que los costos económicos son necesarios para garantizar que Irán no posea armas nucleares. Estados Unidos lleva décadas manteniendo sanciones contra Irán, en su mayoría para reducir sus ingresos petroleros, limitar el sector de la aviación, las criptomonedas, la adquisición de componentes de armas y otro material militar. También busca cortar la financiación a las empresas controladas por el Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica, una fuerza dominante en la economía iraní. Las sanciones excluyen a las entidades designadas del sistema financiero basado en el dólar, pero Teherán ha logrado crear rápidamente nuevas empresas pantalla, otras entidades y matrículas de buques para eludir las sanciones.

item.title: From Tokyo to London, heatwaves send men to work in shorts
item.description: Scorching summer temperatures have done what decades of dress-down Fridays have failed to do — get men to the office in shorts.
item.dc:creator: Agnieszka Olenska, Helen Reid, James Davey
item.content:encoded: Scorching summer temperatures have done what decades of dress-down Fridays have failed to do — get men to the office in shorts. Japan's capital led the way. This year the metropolitan government's long-standing no-tie, no-jacket [USN:L6N43H0CH TEXT:""Cool Biz""] campaign took a step further by encouraging its staff to ditch long trousers, and even try T-shirts and sneakers. As [USN:L8N44G0YD TEXT:"heatwaves mounted"] across Europe, other workers followed in Tokyo's wake, sometimes with the encouragement of authorities and management, sometimes without. LINE BETWEEN COMMUTER AND HOLIDAY STYLES BLURRING Major retailers told Reuters linen shorts and suits were flying off the shelves in Britain, as men opted for breathable fabrics more commonly associated with Mediterranean climes. "The lines between 'commuter' and 'holiday' style are blurring," Martha Hibberd, menswear buyer at British department store John Lewis, said. Marks and Spencer (MKS.L) said sales of men's linen trousers in June to July jumped 183% compared with the same period a year ago. H&M (HMb.ST) — one of Europe's biggest fashion retailers — said it was bringing in lighter clothes and delaying the release of autumnal lines to later in the year. "It looks like we're not going back when it comes to climate change," Andreas Lowenstam, H&M's head of menswear design, said. Hugo Boss said it has increased its assortment of tailored shorts. Its "Boss by Beckham" range in collaboration with soccer star David Beckham, offers a pair of cotton tailored shorts for €229 ($267.27). 'SHORTS ARE FOR WEEKENDS' The trend was there to see in Europe's business hubs, from London's Canary Wharf to the streets of Frankfurt. But there were some limits. At Norway's largest bank, DNB, staff were welcome to wear shorts and skirts, spokesperson Vidar Korsberg Dalsbo told Reuters. "However, we are probably talking about smarter garments with some length rather than a ballerina skirt or a cheeky pair of 1970s-style soccer shorts." In June, Gianfranco Lot, Switzerland head at insurance group Swiss Re (SRENH.S) , wrote an email to staff with tips on how to stay cool. Alongside the list of suggestions — such as drinking water, breaking when needed, and taking a dip in Lake Zurich just across from the office — there was a quick reminder that "shorts are for weekends". Pushing back against the traditions, there were signs that some workers were prepared to take a stand for their lighter attire. Germany's biggest union, IG Metall, and services sector union Verdi both told Reuters they believed dress codes should be relaxed or waived if necessary at times of higher temperatures. "Summers are getting hotter, heat waves are becoming more frequent, and the strain on workers is noticeably increasing," Moriz Tiedemann, occupational health expert at IG Metall, said. Some were already taking matters into their own hands. In Warsaw, one bus driver decided he had had enough of the standard uniform of long polyester trousers and turned up to work one day this month in a skirt, as a protest. "These materials make us sweat and overheat," said the man, who only gave his name as Darek. At the last count, a petition launched by one of his colleagues, asking the Polish capital's transport authority ZTM to let drivers wear shorts during hot weather, had collected more than 400 signatures. ($1 = 0.8568 euros)

item.title: Trump amenaza arancel del 50% a todos los autos y camiones en disputa comercial con Canadá
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró en una publicación en redes sociales el lunes que los aranceles a todos los autos y camiones, las autopartes y el acero se incrementarán al 50% a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, tras el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales con Canadá.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Daphne Psaledakis
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró en una publicación en redes sociales el lunes que los aranceles a todos los autos y camiones, las autopartes y el acero se incrementarán al 50% a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, tras el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales con Canadá. El acuerdo comercial que se estaba negociando habría reducido la tasa arancelaria máxima sobre los autos y las furgonetas canadienses del 25% al 15%, y los gravámenes al aluminio y el acero del 50% al 25%. Sin embargo, se rompió por una serie de desacuerdos, como si la reducción arancelaria estadounidense se habría aplicado a los camiones de carga media o pesada. "Si se fabrica en Estados Unidos, los aranceles son CERO. ¡Canadá ya no recibirá el mismo trato que un estado!", escribió Trump. "En materia de comercio, y también en otros aspectos, se encuentran entre las peores naciones del mundo con las que tratar. Se creen con derecho a todo y, sin embargo, ¡NOSOTROS NO NECESITAMOS A CANADÁ, SON ELLOS LOS QUE NOS NECESITAN!", agregó. Trump quiere que Canadá se siente a la mesa y negocie de buena fe, declaró el lunes a periodistas el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent. En tanto, en una conferencia de prensa en Quebec, el primer ministro Mark Carney afirmó que era posible llegar a un "acuerdo mutuamente beneficioso" con Washington, pero únicamente si Estados Unidos respeta la soberanía de Canadá. "Cuando los estadounidenses se presenten primero a la mesa de negociaciones con la actitud correcta hacia nuestra industria y un verdadero espíritu de colaboración, por supuesto que nos sentaremos a negociar", señaló Carney. LAZOS DE COMERCIO, INTEGRACIÓN Canadá ha sido siempre uno de los dos principales socios comerciales de Estados Unidos. El año pasado, el comercio de bienes y servicios entre los países ascendió a 872.300 millones de dólares, lo que supone un descenso del 4,6%. Canadá exportó más de tres cuartas partes de sus productos a Estados Unidos e importó casi la mitad de los suyos de su vecino del sur. La producción de autos en Estados Unidos está muy integrada con la de Canadá y México, y los aranceles —dependiendo de los detalles— podrían tener repercusiones drásticas en la producción estadounidense. La Casa Blanca no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios en la que se pidieron más detalles sobre los aranceles con los que se había amenazado. Los representantes del Gobierno canadiense tampoco respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Canadá impondrá aranceles a algunos productos estadounidenses a partir del 8 de septiembre, en represalia por los gravámenes del 50% impuestos por Trump a productos canadienses por valor de 20.000 millones de dólares. "Estás en guerra cuando te atacan. Nos han atacado", declaró el sábado el primer ministro Mark Carney cuando se le preguntó si Canadá está inmerso en una guerra comercial. Muchos fabricantes de automóviles han anunciado o están barajando planes para reducir la producción en Canadá, y el enfrentamiento comercial ha provocado una reducción del 22% en las importaciones canadienses de vehículos estadounidenses. Los principales fabricantes de automóviles no se pronunciaron de inmediato sobre el anuncio de Trump. Sin embargo, algunos ejecutivos del sector, que hablaron con Reuters bajo condición de anonimato, se mostraron escépticos, señalando que Trump ya anunció antes aranceles elevados que nunca se materializaron y que cualquier gravamen de esa magnitud probablemente provocaría una represalia masiva por parte de Canadá. También señalaron que aún faltarán meses varios meses hasta enero tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre y que la amenaza de Trump podría tener como objetivo reanudar las negociaciones.

item.title: 英国、ウクライナにミサイル部品の機密開示へ－防空能力強化を支援
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 英国のバーナム首相は24日、ウクライナを訪問し、ゼレンスキー大統領への支持を示すとともに、冬を前にウクライナの防空能力強化を支援する方針を表明した。同氏は、長距離巡航ミサイル「スカルプ」に使われる英国製部品に関する機密情報について、英防衛企業MBDAによる開示を認めると発表した。

バーナム氏はウクライナによるロシアへの抵抗を、第2次世界大戦での英国のナチス・ドイツとの戦いになぞらえ、結束を強調した。7月の首相就任以来、バーナム氏は国内政策を優先してきたが、国際舞台での指導力も強調したい考えだ。

ウクライナ独立35周年を記念し、キーウの聖ソフィア大聖堂前で行った演説で、バーナム氏は「ウクライナ国民の圧倒的な強さには、心から畏敬の念を抱く」と述べ、「20世紀にはわが国が欧州の自由の炎を守り続けた。21世紀にはあなた方がその炎を守っている。ロシアはわが国に言語道断の脅しをかけているが、われわれはウクライナへの支援を続ける」と呼びかけた。

バーナム氏は同日、ゼレンスキー氏と「有志連合」による会合も共同主催した。ドイツのメルツ首相やフランスのマクロン大統領がオンライン参加したとみられる。

スカルプは、英国の長距離巡航ミサイル「ストームシャドー」のフランス製造版で、両ミサイルには英仏共通の技術が使われている。情報開示により、フランスとウクライナは早ければ今年末にも、ウクライナ国内でスカルプを組み立てられるようになる。

ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官は24日、スカルプに使われる英国製部品の機密情報開示の計画について、ロシア政府は「極めて否定的」に受け止めていると記者団に述べた。ペスコフ氏は「英国はウクライナ政府側に立ってこの戦争に参加し、組織的かつ継続的に火に油を注ぎ、和平プロセスのいかなる進展も阻止しようと策を巡らせている」と語った。

同氏は、ロシア軍がこうしたミサイルの生産拠点の特定を進めており、「関連施設を破壊するための措置を講じている」としている。

item.title: Trump threatens 50% tariffs on all cars and trucks from Canada amid trade fight
item.description: President Donald Trump on Monday threatened to raise U.S. tariffs on all cars, trucks and automotive parts from Canada to 50% starting January 1, 2027, escalating a trade fight after negotiations collapsed last week.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Daphne Psaledakis
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump on Monday threatened to raise U.S. tariffs on all cars, trucks and automotive parts from Canada to 50% starting January 1, 2027, escalating a trade fight after [USN:T5N43900P TEXT:"negotiations collapsed last week"]. The trade deal on the table would have cut the top-line tariff rate on Canadian cars and light-duty trucks from 25% to 15% and the tariffs on aluminum and steel from 50% to 25%, but the deal fell apart on Friday over a number of points of contention, including whether the U.S. tariff relief would have applied to medium- or heavy-duty trucks. The escalation threatens to disrupt one of the world's most integrated auto supply chains. U.S. auto production is heavily reliant on Canadian-made parts and vehicles, and higher tariffs could raise costs for American automakers and consumers while deepening a trade standoff that has already weighed on auto stocks. "Build in the U.S. and there are ZERO TARIFFS. Canada will be treated like a State no longer!" Trump wrote in a social media post. "On Trade, and in other ways, also, they are among the worst Nations in the World to deal with. They feel entitled, and yet, WE DON’T NEED CANADA, THEY NEED US!" Trump said. Trump wants Canada to come to the table and negotiate in good faith, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told reporters on Monday. At a press conference in Quebec on Monday, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said a "mutually beneficial deal" with the U.S. was possible, but only if Americans respect Canada's sovereignty. "When the Americans go to the negotiating table first with the right attitude toward our industry and a true partnership, of course we'll come to the negotiating table," Carney said at a briefing announcing an investment in six new Canadian icebreaker ships. AUTO STOCKS DECLINE ON TRUMP WARNING Auto stocks fell on the news. Shares of Ford (F.N) and Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , were down 3.6% and 4.2%, respectively, while shares of General Motors (GM.N) were down 1.6% on Monday afternoon. Toyota (7203.T) , stock was down 1.5% in New York trading and Honda (7267.T) , shares were down 2.1%. Canada has consistently been one of the top two U.S. trading partners and last year, U.S. goods and services trade with Canada totaled $872.3 billion, down 4.6%. Canada exported about three-quarters of its goods to the U.S. and imported almost half of its goods from the U.S., the U.S. Trade Representative's Office said. Flavio Volpe, president of Canada's Automotive Parts Manufacturers' Association, said: "A threatened U.S. tariff on Canadian auto parts will be paid by (the) US auto assembly. Without those specific parts, auto assembly throughout the U.S. would halt." The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment seeking more details on the threatened tariffs. CANADA ANNOUNCES RETALIATORY TARIFFS [USN:L1N44J034 TEXT:"Canada will impose tariffs"] on some U.S. goods starting September 8 in retaliation for 50% levies ordered by Trump on $20 billion in Canadian products. "You're at war when you get attacked. We got attacked," Carney said on Saturday when asked whether Canada was engaged in a trade war. Three in four Canadians approved of Carney’s decision to walk away from trade negotiations with the United States late on Friday night, according to an opinion poll by the Angus Reid Institute on Sunday. Many automakers have announced or are considering plans to scale back Canadian auto production and the trade standoff has led to a 22% reduction in Canadian imports of U.S. vehicles, according to the White House. Major automakers did not immediately comment on Trump's announcement. INDUSTRY SKEPTICISM OVER TARIFF Auto executives, speaking to Reuters on condition of anonymity, raised skepticism about Trump's threat, noting that he has previously announced tariffs that were later scaled back or delayed. They also noted that January was months after the upcoming U.S. midterm elections in November, and that Trump's threat could be aimed at restarting talks. In January of this year, Trump said the U.S. would decertify Bombardier Global Express business jets and threatened 50% import tariffs on all aircraft made in Canada until the country's regulator certified a number of planes produced by U.S. rival Gulfstream. Neither occurred, but [USN:L1N3ZK0S8 TEXT:"the following month Canada certified"] several Gulfstream planes.

item.title: L'Ukraine veut la paix, mais ne se soumettra pas, dit Zelensky
item.description: L'Ukraine veut la paix mais elle ne se soumettra jamais à la Russie, a déclaré lundi le président Volodimir Zelensky dans un discours pugnace prononcé à l'occasion du 35e anniversaire de l'Indépendance de son pays.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
item.content:encoded: L'Ukraine veut la paix mais elle ne se soumettra jamais à la Russie, a déclaré lundi le président Volodimir Zelensky dans un discours pugnace prononcé à l'occasion du 35e anniversaire de l'Indépendance de son pays. Flanqué du Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham et du président du Conseil européen, Antonio Costa, le président ukrainien a salué la résilience de son peuple après plus de quatre années de guerre. "L'Ukraine veut absolument la paix, mais elle n'est pas prête à capituler", a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky, se disant convaincu que Moscou ne mettrait pas fin à sa guerre d'invasion si Kyiv acceptait de lui céder davantage de territoires dans l'est du pays, une des conditions posées par Vladimir Poutine pour mettre fin au conflit. Vêtu d'une chemise traditionnelle brodée, le dirigeant ukrainien a remercié les dirigeants étrangers qui se sont déplacés à Kyiv pour afficher leur soutien, malgré la menace constante d'attaques de missiles russes, l'Ukraine étant confrontée à une pénurie de moyens de défense antiaérienne américains. Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham, qui a pris ses fonctions le mois dernier, a déclaré que son choix de se rendre à Kyiv pour son premier déplacement à l'étranger témoignait de l'importance qu'il accorde à l'Ukraine. "Nous serons à vos côtés dans ce combat jusqu'au bout, de tout notre coeur et de toute notre âme", a-t-il dit, réitérant son soutien "malgré les menaces scandaleuses de la Russie à l'encontre de mon pays". La Grande-Bretagne a annoncé lundi qu'elle autoriserait Kyiv à accéder à une technologie jusqu'ici classifiée afin de lancer la production de missiles de croisière franco-britanniques à longue portée de type SCALP, capables de mener des frappes en profondeur sur le territoire russe. Réagissant à cette annonce, le Kremlin a accusé Londres de "jeter de l'huile sur le feu", après avoir déjà dit la semaine dernière que la livraison de drones britanniques à l'Ukraine aurait "des conséquences". Andy Burnham a co-présidé lundi une réunion virtuelle de la "Coalition des volontaires" avec le président français Emmanuel Macron et le chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz. "(Les dirigeants de cette coalition) ont exprimé leur détermination à accroître le soutien militaire apporté à l'Ukraine, à renforcer sa défense aérienne en priorité absolue, à intensifier la coopération avec son industrie de défense et à partager les technologies pertinentes, notamment par le biais de la Coalition antibalistique", lit-on dans un communiqué de la coalition. Les missiles balistiques russes ont pilonné les villes ukrainiennes ces dernières semaines, profitant de l'épuisement des stocks de missiles intercepteurs Patriot américains du fait la guerre entre les États-Unis et l'Iran. "Les dirigeants ont condamné les frappes systématiques et de plus en plus intenses menées par la Russie contre les villes, les infrastructures essentielles et les civils ukrainiens, qui ont causé le plus grand nombre de victimes civiles depuis le début de l'invasion à grande échelle en 2022", poursuit le communiqué de la Coalition des volontaires. Le président ukrainien a déclaré samedi que l'effort de guerre de Kyiv était compliqué par un déficit de financement de 27 milliards de dollars cette année. Il a également averti que la Russie pourrait opter pour une nouvelle escalade en se préparant à mobiliser quelque 300.000 soldats supplémentaires après les élections législatives du mois prochain. Rendant hommage au peuple ukrainien et aux soldats qui défendent l'Ukraine, Volodimir Zelensky a appelé les alliés à lui fournir "tout" ce qui est nécessaire pour mettre fin au conflit. "Nous ne vous demandons pas de vous battre à notre place", a-t-il répété.

item.title: トランプ氏、カナダ製自動車への関税を2倍にと表明－対立さらに激化
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、カナダから輸入する自動車・同部品に関する関税を来年から2倍に引き上げると表明した。両国の貿易紛争が一段と激化する。

トランプ氏は24日、「全ての自動車とトラック、大型・小型共に、および自動車部品、鉄鋼に対する関税率」を来年1月1日に50%に引き上げると、自身のSNSトゥルース・ソーシャルに投稿した。

自動車に対する関税率は現在25%で、このうち米国で生産された部品などの価値を除いた部分のみに適用されている。輸入鉄鋼には既に50%の関税が課されている。

米国とカナダの交渉は21日に決裂し、米国は多くのカナダ製品に対する関税率を50%に引き上げた。トランプ氏による今回の新たな警告は、対立に拍車を掛けるものだ。カナダのカーニー首相は、米国による関税と同額の報復関税を9月8日から課すと表明している。

自動車関税が実際に引き上げられれば、過去数十年にわたって緊密に一体化してきた米国とカナダのサプライチェーンに大きな混乱をもたらす可能性がある。

トランプ氏はこれまでにも自動車部品に関税を課す方針を示してきたが、実務面で複雑な作業を伴うことから実施には至っていなかった。

自動車に含まれる米国産部分を関税対象から除外する現行措置を、トランプ政権がどのように扱うのかは、現時点で明らかになっていない。この除外措置は実際の関税負担を大きく左右する。カナダから輸入される自動車は通常、半分を米国で生産するため、実際に課される関税率は表面上の税率の半分程度となっている。

原題：Trump Vows to Double Canadian Auto Tariffs, Escalating Fight (1)（抜粋）

item.title: H.B. Fuller rejects Ancora's $1.2 billion bid for adhesive unit
item.description: H.B. Fuller said on Monday its board unanimously rejected activist investor Ancora's unsolicited proposal to acquire its Building Adhesives Solutions (BAS) business, arguing that the offer significantly undervalued the unit.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: H.B. Fuller (FUL.N) said on Monday its board unanimously rejected activist investor Ancora's unsolicited proposal to acquire its Building Adhesives Solutions (BAS) business, arguing that the offer significantly undervalued the unit. In a letter to Ancora, H.B. Fuller said the proposal ignored the unit's growth prospects and lacked key details regarding Ancora's ability to execute the deal. "As key construction end markets recover and benefit from tailwinds such as the data center buildout, we expect BAS to be a significant driver of earnings moving forward," said H.B. Fuller's board chair, Teresa Rasmussen. Earlier this month, Ancora had [USN:L4N449146 TEXT:"proposed to buy"] Fuller's unit for as much as $1.2 billion in cash. Rasmussen added that carving out the BAS business would result in material operating inefficiencies as it shares manufacturing infrastructure with the company's other businesses. A surge in dealmaking activity has fueled campaigns by activist investors, who push companies to sell their entire business or parts of it, putting boards and management teams under greater pressure. "By rejecting the offer without any engagement, CEO Celeste Mastin and the board have reinforced their proclivity for entrenchment," Ancora's President Jim Chadwick told Reuters. Chadwick added that Ancora could self-finance a transaction, increase its offer and move quickly to address the company's leverage crisis. Ancora also criticized H.B. Fuller's response to the bid, saying it strengthened its case for board changes and claimed there was interest in both the BAS segment and the entire company from other parties.

item.title: Strategy earmarks $1.6 billion cash pool for treasury operations, buybacks
item.description: Michael Saylor's Strategy set aside about $1.6 billion in cash to fund future treasury operations, including potential bitcoin purchases and share buybacks, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR.O) set aside about $1.6 billion in cash to fund future treasury operations, including potential bitcoin purchases and share buybacks, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing on Monday. The world's largest corporate buyer of bitcoin dubbed the liquidity pool "USD Cash," which will be different from a reserve it set up earlier to fund dividends on its preferred stock and interest on its outstanding debt. The new cash pool will have more flexible uses and could be used for bitcoin purchases, share buybacks and other corporate events. It could also give Strategy more flexibility to navigate bitcoin market downturns, allowing it to maintain cash on hand, while continuing to pursue its bitcoin-buying strategy. The move comes after a robust week for bitcoin, which gained a little over 13% in the last five sessions after U.S. President Donald Trump urged Congress to pass legislation establishing clear rules for digital assets. Bitcoin breached the $70,000 mark last week, for the first time since June. Risk assets, like cryptocurrencies, have also benefited after the U.S. Treasury Department's move to double buyback sizes for long-duration debt reined in yields. Higher yields are typically a negative for such assets because they increase the returns on safer investments. Still, bitcoin remains far from the peaks it hit after a staggering run last year.

item.title: Washington Post ordered to reinstate columnist Karen Attiah
item.description: A private arbitrator ordered the newspaper to reinstate Attiah with back pay after she was fired over social media posts about Charlie Kirk's assassination.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A private arbitrator has ordered The Washington Post to reinstate opinion columnist Karen Attiah with back pay, after the newspaper fired her in September over social media posts about conservative activist [USN:L2N3UX0YE TEXT:"Charlie Kirk's assassination"]. The ruling, made public by the Democracy Defenders Fund on Monday, comes as the Post's opinion section faces scrutiny following a push by owner Jeff Bezos to focus on [USN:L2N3PH0XF TEXT:"personal liberties and free markets"]. Here are some more details: Private arbitrator Sarah Miller Espinosa found the newspaper "did not have good and sufficient cause" to terminate Attiah and had "violated" its labor agreement. "The Washington Post failed to establish the grievant engaged in gross misconduct," she wrote. "This decision confirms what we've said from the start: I was doing my job as an opinion journalist, and doing that job is not misconduct," said Attiah. A Washington Post spokesperson said the newspaper respects the arbitration process and declined to comment further. The dispute began after Attiah's posts on social media platform Bluesky following Kirk's September 2025 assassination, including one in which she noted Kirk's past comments on Black women. The Post had said in its termination letter that Attiah's posts violated its social media policy, which requires employees' online activity to be respectful and not undermine the integrity of the newspaper's journalism. In February, The Washington Post [USN:L6N3Z015A TEXT:"began layoffs"] impacting a third of its employees, across its international, editing, metro and sports desks amid mounting financial losses. The New York Times first reported the arbitration decision earlier in the day.

item.title: Putin allows Russia to take control of infrastructure deemed vulnerable to drone attacks
item.description: President Vladimir Putin on Monday handed the Russian state the power to take control of critically important infrastructure if it is deemed to be poorly protected from Ukrainian drone attacks and other threats.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Vladimir Putin on Monday handed the Russian state the power to take control of critically important infrastructure if it is deemed to be poorly protected from Ukrainian drone attacks and other threats. The special powers, set out in a presidential decree, will allow the state to take over temporary administration of such facilities at a time when Ukraine has stepped up drone attacks on oil refineries and retail warehouses. The state will be able to take control of physical and financial assets and formal ownership rights if entities responsible for such facilities are judged to have failed in their duty to protect them and are too slow to repair them after any attack, according to the decree. It applies to fuel, energy, industrial, communications, transport and logistics facilities and other objects regarded as critically-important for ensuring the security and economic stability of the state and the population. First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov said the measure should not be viewed as a precursor to nationalisation and would not be used on a broad scale. "This does not involve nationalisation or a change of ownership. The decree provides for the state to take part in managing an enterprise in order to address specific security issues," Manturov was quoted as saying by Interfax. Putin last week [USN:L8N44G0XL TEXT:"ordered the government"] to launch a programme to rebuild commercial warehouses damaged or destroyed by Ukraine in recent weeks. Kyiv has attacked at least two dozen warehouses belonging to Russia's top [USN:L1N43K018 TEXT:"online retailer Wildberries"] since July 18, destroying a large chunk of its storage capacity. On Monday, Russia's second-largest online retailer Ozon , said four of its logistics hubs in southern Russia had been [USN:L1N44L05J TEXT:"targeted in Ukrainian attacks"].

FAST

Aug 24 : The U.S. Federal Trade Commission and a group of states settled with Zillow ahead of trial on Monday, ending claims the online real estate platform illegally paid Rocket Companies' Redfin $100 million to stop competing in apartment rental listings. The FTC and five states were ready to argue at trial scheduled to start Monday that the Zillow-Redfin partnership drove up costs for landlords and decreased listing quality for renters. More than 30 per cent of Americans rent their homes, according to census data.  Under the settlement, Redfin can continue to display Zillow ads on its sites but will resume its rental advertising business within six months, the FTC and states said. While Democratic state attorneys general have clashed with the Trump administration on other matters, both the FTC and the states called the settlement a win.

New York Attorney General Letitia James said the lawsuit restored competition in online listing platforms, "critical tools that New Yorkers rely on to find affordable homes." Virginia, Arizona, Connecticut and Washington were also plaintiffs. FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson said the settlement will provide competition in rental markets that is "an integral component of President Donald Trump’s domestic housing agenda." A Redfin spokesperson said the settlement allows the company to maintain its partnership with Zillow through at least 2030 while building its own rentals business. Zillow rentals executive Michael Sherman said the settlement is positive and "enables us to keep our energy on innovating for renters and property managers." ZILLOW-REDFIN PARTNERSHIP ALLEGEDLY RAISED AD PRICES Zillow and Redfin made a deal in February 2025: Redfin would wind down its rental listing business, refer its customers to Zillow, and display copies of Zillow's listings on its site. Redfin agreed to stay out of the business for up to nine years. In return, Zillow agreed to pay Redfin $100 million, plus fees for each renter who signaled interest in a property.  The FTC sued the companies, as did New York, Virginia, Arizona, Connecticut and Washington. They said that before the deal, Zillow and Redfin were competing to list vacancies in buildings with more than 25 units.  After Redfin stopped competing, Zillow customers paid an average of 14.5 per cent more per listing, an expert for the FTC and states estimated, while some property managers stopped buying online listings. Zillow had said in court papers that the deal put more listings on both sites and helped it compete with market leader CoStar Group. Exclusive deals are common in the industry, Zillow had said.
